chapters.title: Chapter 307: Marrec Crushes Nolan Without Using His Full Strength!
paragraphs: Two of the Sear spheres behind Marrec suddenly acted.
Fwoosh!
They released a short but powerful burst of Infernal Flame toward the upper-left side.
And the thrust pushed him sideways and upward.
His body shifted just enough.
Nolan’s sword missed.
BOOM!
The greatsword crashed into the arena floor.
The impact erupted into an explosion, sending debris outward and carving a crater roughly ten meters deep into the reinforced battlefield.
Nolan’s arms trembled from the force of the impact.
Then he realized something.
Marrec was already standing a short distance away, completely unharmed.
The five Sear spheres that remained active behind him were glowing intensely.
’Shit!’
Nolan immediately tried to move.
"Sear Barrage."
But, Five concentrated beams of Infernal Flame shot from the remaining Sear spheres.
They were much denser than the earlier attacks.
One aimed toward his chest.
Another toward his head.
The others targeted his stomach and legs.
Nolan’s instincts screamed.
’Damn it!’
He raised his greatsword in front of himself, trying to protect his head and heart while twisting his body to minimize the remaining impact.
The beams reached him.
BOOOM!
BOOOM!
BOOOM!
BOOOM!
BOOOM!
Five explosions erupted almost simultaneously.
The shockwaves rolled across the area.
At the same time, Marrec used Sear Drift again, causing the other Sear spheres to push his body backward and safely out of the attack’s range.
He landed lightly.
The dust created by Nolan’s impact slowly began to settle.
Then a faint sound came from below.
Nolan’s pained grunt echoed from inside the crater.
The battlefield beneath him had been blown apart.
He had been thrown nearly one hundred meters from the original impact point, and both of his legs were gone from the knees down.
Even the silver greatsword he had been using was badly charred, its surface blackened from the intense heat.
This wasn’t some ordinary weapon either.
It was a proper B-rank sword.
The fact that it had been damaged so severely showed just how concentrated Marrec’s Infernal Flame attacks were.
Kira’s hands immediately rose to her mouth.
"He’s alive..."
Relief mixed with worry in her voice.
She forced herself to keep her voice down, afraid that shouting too loudly might distract Nolan or disturb the battle.
Zeyr’s expression remained serious.
"He should surrender."
Nolan had already managed to force Marrec to use two different abilities, and there was little value in risking his life to learn what else the man had prepared.
Down in the crater, Nolan’s body trembled from the pain.
He took a rough breath.
"I surrender!"
The instant those words left his mouth, Marrec stopped.
The flames behind him gradually settled.
However, the smug look on his face remained.
"As expected."
His gaze moved toward the spectator seats.
"All of you are called special."
He chuckled.
"But in the end, you’re nothing more than people with Origin Skills who believe yourselves superior to those without them."
Marrec didn’t mention one important detail.
Although he was only a Mid-B-rank and Nolan was an Early B-rank, he had never fought Nolan at full strength.
In fact, he had restrained roughly eighty percent of his power.
And the result had still been this one-sided.
"Weakling."
Marrec spat onto the ground before turning back toward the center of the arena.
He simply stood there and waited for the next opponent.
’Bastard.’
Nolan clenched his fist inside the crater, glaring at Marrec with hatred.
But he didn’t answer.
The next moment, Peiro teleported him back to the spectator seats.
"Nolan!"
Kira immediately rushed toward him and hugged his injured body.
"Ahh!"
A sharp cry escaped Nolan because of the sudden pressure against his injuries.
Kira quickly loosened her grip.
But she didn’t care about embarrassing him.
She was simply relieved that he was alive and hadn’t been foolish enough to continue fighting after suffering such severe injuries.
Zeyr also walked over.
"How’s your condition? Do you need special potions, or will normal healing potions be enough?"
Nolan took a breath.
"Ugh... I’m fine. Just normal potions should do."
He tried to smile as he said it.
But with both legs missing and a large charred hole still visible across his stomach, the attempt did little to hide how badly he had been injured.
Zeyr shook his head.
"Even if you’re B-rank, you’re not a dragon. Here, take this."
He handed Nolan a potion without paying attention to his attempt to save face in front of Kira.
"Yeah."
Kira accepted it and carefully helped Nolan drink.
The effect was immediate.
A warm surge of energy spread through his body.
Flesh began regenerating.
His legs slowly reformed, bone appearing first before muscle and skin followed.
The charred section of his stomach closed as fresh flesh replaced the damaged area, while the burns covering his hands and body faded away.
Several Sunborn warriors stared in disbelief.
"That’s a High-grade B-rank potion."
The words escaped from one of them.
Potions of that level were expensive even within the Sunborn Kingdom, and they were rarely used casually because high-rank alchemists were difficult to find.
As a result, the supply never matched the demand.
For this mission, the kingdom had only brought a limited number of Low- to Mid-grade B-rank potions.
Otherwise, they would have been forced to rely on C-rank potions or their natural recovery abilities.
"Thanks."
Nolan looked toward Zeyr.
Zeyr merely shrugged.
Arwen, sitting nearby, gave a faint sneer.
"Humans always remain weak."
Zeyr didn’t respond.
He simply turned around and returned to his seat.
Nolan and Kira ignored the remark as well.
They knew where they stood within this group.
Among the present combatants, they were among the weakest.
Even Marius, despite being a vampire who had not shown much interest in fighting, was stronger than them.
Zeyr had already sent out many of the human combatants earlier because the Sunborn Kingdom’s human representatives had gradually filled the initial battles.
Still, Kira couldn’t help silently cursing the others.
’Those bastards.’
She thought about Arwen, Larael, and Marius.
All three had enough strength and energy to at least push Marrec further than Nolan had.
They could have fought him.
They might not have been able to defeat him, but they could have forced him to reveal more of his abilities.
Kira had even heard that Arwen’s Sun Spirit had once used a special technique called *SOLAR SPEAR OF EXTINCTION* and injured a Mid-B-rank.
Yet none of them had stepped forward.
She didn’t say any of it aloud.
Nolan noticed the expression on her face.
"Kira, are you okay?" He gently patted her head.
Kira nodded. "Hmm."
Meanwhile, Luke watched everything calmly.
He had no intention of stepping forward for Nolan and Kira.
He didn’t know them well enough, and as far as the human race was concerned, Luke had never viewed himself as some kind of saint.
His own people and the people close to him mattered.
Their race was secondary.
Besides, he wasn’t even human anymore.
He was a Titan.
So if Arwen said something even to him, then he would also chose to stay quiet and let him bark, since nothing could be done in this place.
"Kira, be careful."
Nolan’s expression became serious.
He had already experienced firsthand what happened when someone underestimated Marrec or another high-ranking member of the Infernal Choir.
Marrec was a powerful Mid-B-rank, and an Origin Skill user on top of that, which placed him close to the lower level of King-tier Royal Talents in overall threat.
"I will." Kira nodded.
Then she jumped down into the arena.

Still, Kira couldn’t help silently cursing the others.
’Those bastards.’
She thought about Arwen, Larael, and Marius.
All three had enough strength and energy to at least push Marrec further than Nolan had.
They could have fought him.
They might not have been able to defeat him, but they could have forced him to reveal more of his abilities.
Kira had even heard that Arwen’s Sun Spirit had once used a special technique called *SOLAR SPEAR OF EXTINCTION* and injured a Mid-B-rank.
Yet none of them had stepped forward.
She didn’t say any of it aloud.
Nolan noticed the expression on her face.
"Kira, are you okay?" He gently patted her head.
Kira nodded.
"Hmm."
Meanwhile, Luke watched everything calmly.
He had no intention of stepping forward for Nolan and Kira.
He didn’t know them well enough, and as far as the human race was concerned, Luke had never viewed himself as some kind of saint.
His own people and the people close to him mattered.
Their race was secondary.
Besides, he wasn’t even human anymore.
He was a Titan.
So if Arwen said something even to him, then he would also chose to stay quiet and let him bark, since nothing could be done in this place.
"Kira, be careful."
Nolan’s expression became serious.
He had already experienced firsthand what happened when someone underestimated Marrec or another high-ranking member of the Infernal Choir.
Marrec was a powerful Mid-B-rank, and an Origin Skill user on top of that, which placed him close to the lower level of King-tier Royal Talents in overall threat.
"I will." Kira nodded.
Then she jumped down into the arena.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: The Moment Luke Entered the Battle!
paragraphs: Peiro watched calmly from above.
At this point, he no longer bothered announcing the victory count after every individual battle.
The round would ultimately belong to whichever side had a warrior still standing at the end, so the previous tally no longer mattered in the same way.
The Sunborn Kingdom still had warriors capable of fighting, but their condition was deteriorating, and none of them were confident that they could safely face a Mid-B-rank opponent like Marrec.
Sending them in would simply be throwing away lives.
"Let’s start."
Peiro casually waved his hand.
The next battle began.
Kira immediately demonstrated that she was a mage.
Luke noticed it within the first few exchanges.
Her ranged attacks reminded him of Theia and the Arcane Heart system.

At higher levels, mages could prepare and store spells within their Arcane Hearts, allowing them to unleash multiple techniques quickly and making them especially valuable in large-scale battles where mass destruction was required.
But this was not the kind of battle Kira had prepared for.
Marrec’s combat ability overwhelmed her at close and medium range.
Every time she attempted to create distance, he forced her back.
Every time she prepared a stronger spell, one of his Sear spheres disrupted her before she could fully release it.
Luke watched carefully.
"She doesn’t have many highly concentrated single-target attacks."
Selene, seating beside him, also noticed the same thing.
Kira could produce powerful attacks, but she didn’t seem to have a technique capable of gathering a massive amount of power into one precise point against an opponent as strong as Marrec.
Meanwhile, Nolan watched the fight with growing concern.
He could tell Kira was pushing herself harder than she should.
She knew she wasn’t Marrec’s match.
Yet she kept attacking.
"Idiot." Nolan muttered under his breath.
"He’s not someone you can fight just because you’re angry."
He knew exactly why she was doing this.
She was angry because of what had happened to him.
Kira wanted revenge.
She wanted to repay Marrec for humiliating Nolan.
But that wasn’t enough.
Anger meant nothing if the difference in strength remained this large.
Zeyr, Karon, Alia, Estelle, Isaria, Arwen, Larael, and several others had also noticed the same thing.
"Foolish." This time, Larael was the one who commented.
Kira had forgotten a simple truth.
Anger belonged to the strong.
The weak couldn’t rely on anger to bridge an overwhelming difference in power.
Marrec was stronger.
That was why he had been able to defeat both Nolan and Kira while they couldn’t do the same to him.
If someone stronger than Marrec appeared, then he would be the one unable to behave so confidently.
The fight continued.
Kira threw another spell.
Marrec avoided it and countered.
BOOM!
The impact sent her crashing into a section of broken stone.
She rolled across the ground and forced herself back onto her feet.
Blood ran down the side of her face.
She wiped it away and glared toward Marrec.
Then she attacked again.
She refused to stop.
Nolan’s expression became increasingly worried.
"Kira...
He could see her body weakening.
Then, after one particularly intense exchange, her movements slowed.
Her balance faltered, since, she had lost too much blood.
She tried to cast another spell. then her hand trembled and the spell never formed.
Because, her eyes had lost focus.
"No!"
Nolan suddenly shouted.
Kira’s body collapsed into the debris scattered across the arena.
She had lost consciousness.
"Lord Peiro!"
Nolan turned toward the blue spirit.
"She can’t fight anymore! Please, take her out!"
Peiro looked down from above. His expression remained calm.
Nolan’s face tightened.
He already knew what would happen if no one intervened.
’Marrec will kill her.’
Marrec wasn’t a saint.
He belonged to the Demon Whisper organization, people who had burned villages and killed innocent civilians without hesitation.
Nolan couldn’t simply sit there and watch Kira die.
"I can’t let her die!"
Gritting his teeth, he tried to leap down from the spectator seat.
But something stopped him.
"What?!"
Nolan’s body collided with an invisible barrier.
His hands pressed against nothing.
Yet something solid was clearly there.
A transparent force prevented him from leaving the spectator area.
They hadn’t felt it earlier.
It seemed the barrier only became active once a battle was underway.
Zeyr examined the invisible wall.
"This barrier is composed of multiple layers of power."
He pressed a hand against it, testing the surface.
"It’s too strong to break quickly."
He shook his head reluctantly.
"I don’t think we can get through it in time."
His expression darkened.
He didn’t want any representative of Empyrean Academy to die here, regardless of their race.
Ivar was already dead.
If Kira died as well, it would leave a terrible impression on him.
His peers, even the dragons, would question how weak he was that he couldn’t bring his own squad back safely.
"This can’t be." Nolan’s eyes widened.
His attention snapped back toward the arena.
Marrec was walking toward Kira.
Slowly.
Step by step.
Step.
Step.
Step.
Although Marrec didn’t particularly enjoy killing the weak, he did enjoy killing talented people, especially when he could break their pride first.
"Another useless human."
His voice carried across the arena.
He glanced toward the Sunborn side.
His eyes first settled on Nolan.
Nolan’s pleading expression brought a smile to Marrec’s face.
Then his gaze shifted toward Luke.
Luke was sitting there calmly, looking directly into Marrec’s eyes without showing any obvious emotion.
"After her, your turn will come."
Marrec smiled broadly and made a slow cutting gesture across his neck before continuing toward the unconscious Kira.
Selene’s expression darkened.
"Should I kill him?"
She clearly didn’t like the idea of a mere Mid-B-rank threatening her husband.
Luke shook his head. "No need."
Selene looked at him in confusion.
"I thought you had gained some pride."
Her tone wasn’t mocking.
She genuinely didn’t understand his reaction.
"Your earlier actions also seemed to show that."
Luke smiled. "Since I’m here, why should my beautiful wife have to deal with that pest?"
He leaned toward her and gently kissed her cheek before standing up.
Their conversation went unnoticed by most of the others.
Everyone’s attention remained fixed on the arena, especially on Marrec, Nolan’s desperate shouting, and Kira’s unconscious body.
"Please! Don’t do this!"
Nolan’s voice echoed through the arena.
"She isn’t in fighting condition anymore!"
"Lord Peiro, please take her back!"
But his voice grew weaker as Marrec continued walking.
Peiro, however, wasn’t watching Nolan.
His gaze was fixed on something else.
Or perhaps someone.
’What will he do?’ A small smile appeared on Peiro’s face.
Below, the answer came.
Luke’s body changed.
Valzareth armor materialized around him, dark metal covering his body in smooth layers.
At the same time, he transformed into the Nyx Titan.
His figure rapidly grew until he reached twenty feet in height.
The black armor covered nearly every part of his body, while his helmet sealed shut over his face.
Only his long black hair escaped from the back, tied into a ponytail that hung behind him.
His appearance had changed completely.
He no longer looked like the relaxed Luke who had been sitting beside Selene.
He looked like an ancient warrior preparing to enter the battlefield.
Selene’s hands rose slightly in amazement.
Luke looked impressive in that form and she couldn’t deny it.
Luke turned toward her.
Through the dark visor of his helmet, his eyes met hers.
Then he winked.
The gesture was completely at odds with his intimidating appearance.
Before she could react, Luke vanished.
*Void Step.*

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Luke Blocks a Mid-B-Rank’s Attack With One Hand!
paragraphs: The spatial movement carried him away.
Meanwhile, everyone’s attention was still on Marrec.
He had stopped above Kira and raised his right hand, in his floating form.
One of the Sear spheres behind him slowly descended toward his palm.
The moment it touched his hand, the sphere transformed.
Its flames stretched outward, extending into a long sword formed entirely from condensed Infernal Flame.
Marrec looked down at Kira.
"Weak don’t have the right to live."
His voice became colder.
"Just as your kind did to me."
His right arm moved.
The Infernal Flame sword descended.
The swing was so fast that the air compressed violently around the blade.
BOOM!
A sonic boom exploded across the arena.
SHWOOOOOM!
The blade cut downward.
CLANG!
A metallic impact rang out.
A cloud of dust immediately rose from the point of impact.
For a brief moment, no one understood what had happened.
The first sound had been obvious.
That had been the sonic boom produced by Marrec’s swing.
But the second—
Clang?
That wasn’t the sound of flesh being cut.
It was metal striking metal.
"Armor?" The word escaped Nolan’s mouth through a voice filled with disbelief.
His eyes widened as he stared into the dust cloud.
Everyone else did the same.
Slowly, the dust began to clear.
Marrec was still standing.
His Infernal Flame sword was lowered slightly.
And below him—
Kira was safe.
Standing between them was a twenty-foot-tall figure clad entirely in sleek black armor.
The armored figure’s right hand was holding Marrec’s Infernal Flame sword.
The blade had been stopped directly against the armor.
Infernal Flame spread across its surface, trying to burn through the dark metal, but it couldn’t.
Instead, the space around the armored hand continued to ripple.
The area around the sword looked distorted, almost as though the blade were trying to push through several kilometers of thick, viscous water.
But it couldn’t advance even an inch.
A few stunned voices escaped from the spectator seats.
"Black Knight?"
Then Nolan recognized him.
"Luke!" His earlier disbelief turned into shock.
The same reaction appeared across the spectators.
"Luke? How?!
Even Arwen and Larael rose from their seats in disbelief.
The entire arena was enclosed by a barrier.
A peak B-rank barrier, at that.
Yet Luke had crossed it.
And not only that, he had appeared fifty kilometers away in an instant. "This is absurd."
Peiro watched from above.
A smile appeared on his face as he shook his head.
"Forbidden elements are truly forbidden."
The others didn’t understand Luke method.
Peiro did.
The arena’s barrier had been designed to withstand destruction reaching the peak B-rank level.
It blocked physical attacks and also restricted spatial movement.
Under normal circumstances, no one should have been able to simply teleport through it.
But Luke’s Void Step was different.
Valzareth treated the spatial restrictions almost like they weren’t there.
The armor allowed Luke to bypass the barrier through Void travel.
After crossing the barrier, Luke had used Void Step five times in succession to reach the center of the arena.
Peiro could have stopped him.
If he truly wished to, he could have sealed the space of the entire arena so completely that even gods would have been unable to move through it.
In that situation, even Valzareth wouldn’t have been able to overcome the restriction.
Luke’s armor still hadn’t been fully unlocked.
Neither had his realm.
But Peiro wasn’t particularly bothered.
"Whatever."
He shook his head, clearly impressed by Luke’s Void ability.
Yet another question remained.
"What is that affinity?"
Peiro focused on Luke.
He could perceive four different affinities surrounding the young Titan.
The first was pitch black.
Void Affinity.
The second was a deep golden-white.
Cosmic Affinity.
The third carried the appearance of shifting rainbow colors.
Seal Affinity.
And the fourth—
Pure white.
It was so white that Peiro couldn’t even properly describe it as white.
It almost felt as though the affinity itself had chosen that color simply because it was the closest color available to describe it.
"Weird affinity."
Those words escaped Peiro’s mouth.
If the Endless Prison Reality had been present, it would probably have agreed.
After all, the fourth affinity belonged to Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan.
And among the Titans, Myrkhal was one of the strangest.
While Peiro was still thinking about it, Luke’s calm voice came from below.
"Sir Peiro, can you move Kira out? She can’t fight anymore."
Luke was still holding Marrec’s Infernal Flame sword in one hand while asking.
Several people in the spectator seats interpreted his behavior differently.
After interfering with the battle and crossing the barrier, Luke was now casually asking Peiro to remove Kira from the arena.
To them, it looked like arrogance.
Peiro, however, didn’t complain.
"Kira of the Sunborn Kingdom has been defeated."
His voice carried across the arena.
"Luke Voidheart will fight in the new round."
The moment he finished speaking, Kira’s unconscious body disappeared and was teleported back to the spectator seat.
"Kira!"
Nolan immediately caught her.
He hugged her tightly, checking her breathing.
When he felt the warmth of her breath against his chest, relief finally washed over him.
"Thank you, Sir Luke." His sincere voice came.
But Luke didn’t hear it.
His attention remained on the man standing directly in front of him.
Marrec’s expression had darkened.
"Oh, Hero of Light." Hatred filled his voice.
"This time, you won’t be able to run."
He pushed more force into the Infernal Flame sword.
The blade pressed harder against Luke’s armor.
Marrec wanted to cut straight through him.
But beneath his helmet, Luke smiled.
His current realm was only Early B-rank.
Yet with his Titan form and the enhancement provided by Valzareth, his physical strength was far beyond what his cultivation rank alone suggested.
There was also the reason he had managed to stop the previous strike.
Luke had alos used eighty percent of his Void energy to create a five-kilometer-wide layer of Void Horizon around his palm.
The stretched space drastically reduced the sword’s momentum before the blade finally reached his armor.
After that, his Early B-rank physical strength and Valzareth armor were enough to withstand the remaining force.
Marrec increased the pressure. The sword pushed downward.
Luke didn’t move.
Then the space beside Marrec rippled.
Once.
Twice.
Before Marrec could turn his head, two completely white, faceless Titans materialized on either side of him.
Both were twenty feet tall.
Their bodies were covered in Null-ex Armor.
They moved at the same time.
Their legs swung horizontally toward Marrec’s waist from opposite directions.
BANG!
BANG!
The two impacts sounded almost like gigantic cannons firing simultaneously.
Marrec’s body was struck from both sides.
His torso folded slightly under the combined force.
Then he was launched backward.
WHOOSH!
His body flew across the arena before crashing into the ground.
BOOM!
Dust and debris erupted from the impact site. Even a thick cloud rose around him.
"Wow!"
A wave of surprised voices spread across the Sunborn side.

Both were twenty feet tall.
Their bodies were covered in Null-ex Armor.
They moved at the same time.
Their legs swung horizontally toward Marrec’s waist from opposite directions.
BANG!
BANG!
The two impacts sounded almost like gigantic cannons firing simultaneously.
Marrec’s body was struck from both sides.
His torso folded slightly under the combined force.
Then he was launched backward.
WHOOSH!
His body flew across the arena before crashing into the ground.
BOOM!
Dust and debris erupted from the impact site.
Even a thick cloud rose around him.
"Wow!"
A wave of surprised voices spread across the Sunborn side.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Luke Decided To Use New Titan Fusion Form.
paragraphs: Zeyr narrowed his eyes as he analyzed what had just happened.
"He caught the Mid-B-rank by surprise."
His gaze remained fixed on the battlefield.
"And that clone appears to have Early B-rank physical strength as well."
Karon looked equally surprised.
"Earlier, his aura only felt like Half-B-rank, but now even that has reached Early B-rank."
The surprise was shared across the entire group.

From crossing the arena barrier with Void movement, to physically stopping a Mid-B-rank attack without suffering serious damage, and now revealing another increase in his apparent strength, Luke had already overturned most of their expectations.
Larael stared at him in disbelief.
"How can he become this strong while his cultivation is only Early D-rank?"
Everything she had heard about heroes failed to properly explain what she was seeing.
Nolan, meanwhile, had finally stopped staring in shock.
"The legends really are true?" He glanced toward Luke.
"Is the last summoned Hero really the strongest?"
Kira had already regained consciousness after taking the potion and was now watching the battlefield from the spectator seat.
Her eyes remained on Luke. There was clear gratitude in them.
Zeyr shook his head. "I don’t know."
He paused before offering another possibility.
"Maybe all of the heroes summoned this time are abnormal."
He had yet to meet any of the other current heroes.
He hadn’t even encountered the Dragon Hero of this era.
Luke was the first.
That made it difficult to know whether Luke was simply an exception or whether all the current heroes possessed unusual qualities.
The spectators eventually turned toward Selene.
She was smiling proudly.
She had expected Luke to be strong, but even she had been surprised by what he had shown.
"My husband is the best." So, she whispered it softly.
For her, that was enough.
Nolan glanced at her and shook his head.
"She seems completely fallen."
He had never expected the Scarlet Witch to become so deeply attached to someone.
Meanwhile, on the opposite side, Brynessa and Mella were watching the battle closely.
"Miss, is the legend really true?" Mella’s voice carried obvious curiosity.
Even she hadn’t expected the current Hero of Light to be this powerful without having completed his awakening.
Brynessa continued watching Luke as he slowly approached Marrec.
"Legend is indeed true."
She paused.
"But this hero seems unusually powerful."
"Unusually?" Mella quietly repeated the word.
The battle below continued.
Bang!
The dust cloud surrounding Marrec suddenly exploded outward.
He emerged from the rubble, his eyes burning with fury.
"HERO OF LIGHT!"
His voice shook with rage.
"YOU WILL DIE TODAY!"
Marrec raised both arms.
The ten Sear spheres behind him began rotating at high speed.
Then he roared.
"SEARWHEEL!"
"ULTIMATE ABILITY!"
"SEARWHEEL: BATTLE FORM!"
The instant those words left his mouth, the ten spheres stopped rotating.
The first five immediately flew toward him.
They moved with incredible speed.
Before touching his body, each sphere began changing shape.
Dense streams of Infernal Flame wrapped around them, and their spherical forms stretched and transformed into pieces of armor.
The first sphere became the chest and torso armor.
The second transformed into armor covering his right arm.
The third became the armor for his left arm.
The fourth transformed into his right leg armor.
The fifth became the armor covering his left leg.
The five pieces merged together.
Infernal Flame surged between them, locking the armor into place.
Marrec’s body rapidly expanded.
His height increased until he became a fifty-foot-tall giant wearing massive infernal armor resembling the armor of a samurai.
His original body remained sealed within the chest armor.
Even so, his silhouette could still be seen through the flames covering the outer structure.
But the transformation wasn’t finished.
Two of the remaining five Sear spheres rose above him.
Their surfaces expanded, while their flames compressed.
Within moments, they had transformed into two miniature suns made entirely from highly condensed Infernal Flame.
The two spheres rotated around each other above and slightly behind Marrec.
They released a constant supply of Infernal Flame into the Battle Form, maintaining the transformation and feeding energy into the massive body.
Each miniature sun was only about one hundred meters in diameter.
Even at that size, the heat radiating from them was enough to melt a B-rank being who remained too close for too long.
The remaining three Sear spheres also transformed.
One became a gigantic greatsword.
[INFERNAL GREATSWORD]
Dense Infernal Flame packed into the weapon so tightly that the sword behaved almost like solid metal despite being formed entirely from energy.
The second became another defensive structure.
[INFERNAL TORSO ARMOR]
A large reinforced plate formed over the front and back of Marrec’s upper body.
It didn’t fully merge with the primary armor.
Instead, it acted as an additional defensive layer that also protected the real body sealed inside.
Finally, the last Sear sphere transformed.
[INFERNAL CHAINS]
Several long chains emerged, each one made entirely from condensed Infernal Flame.
They wrapped around one of Marrec’s arms.
Unlike ordinary chains, they remained directly connected to his limb and could extend outward over long distances.
Marrec lowered the huge Infernal Greatsword.
"Now DIE!" with that, he charged toward Luke.
The fifty-foot-tall figure moved with surprising speed, each step causing the arena beneath him to tremble as he crossed the distance.
Nolan stared in disbelief.
"What a monster!"
He had finally understood. Marrec had been holding back.
This wasn’t even the same level as the earlier fight.
Zeyr’s expression also became serious.
"Seems he was a prodigy of his time."
The more he observed the Battle Form, the more impressed he became.
Marrec’s Origin Skill wasn’t limited to a single attack.
It could function as offense, defense, mobility, energy supply, and restraint.
That kind of versatility was extremely rare, especially among people at lower ranks.
"Even I would have to use my full strength to defeat him now."
Zeyr admitted after analyzing Marrec’s current state.
On the Infernal Choir’s side, Mella’s expression finally relaxed.
"With this, Luke will die." She whispered the words.
Brynessa didn’t answer. Her gaze remained on Luke.
Somehow, she still didn’t believe, that Luke had shown everything he could do.
Especially Luke’s those strange transformations.
She was right.
Luke was already preparing his next move.
He was going to fuse Azrion, the Atlas Titan, with his current Void Titan form.
The fusion carried a name.
A name that should never have been possible.
A Titan that couldn’t exist naturally in any universe because its very existence violated the rules upon which everything had been constructed.
Luke’s voice was quiet beneath his helmet.
"Vorthar—"
The world around him seemed to grow still for a brief moment.
『The One Who Bears the Endless Void.』

chapters.title: Chapter 311: The Atlas Titan’s Forbidden Art Has Awakened!
paragraphs: The moment those words escaped his lips, Luke’s entire twenty-foot-tall body began to expand rapidly, his frame growing until he reached a height of seventy feet. The lean build of his previous form changed along with it, the smooth muscles becoming more defined and perfectly proportioned to his new size, not excessively bulky or unnaturally thin, but balanced as though his body had been designed specifically to bear this form.
At the same time, the armor covering him began to change.

The black armor transformed into Nullex, and its color shifted completely until Luke was covered in sleek white armor that retained the same overall structure as the previous black armor, although its proportions now suited his larger body perfectly.
Even the helmet retained the same familiar design, almost as though Nullex had been jealous of Valzareth and decided to copy its style.
’Calm down, Nullex.’
Sensing the armor’s bevavoir, Luke smiled inwardly as he reassured it before straightening his posture and calmly looking toward Marrec.
The fifty-foot-tall Marrec was already rushing toward him.
He leaped into the air, raised his gigantic Infernal Greatsword above his head, and swung it downward with tremendous force while roaring,
"DIE!"

The blade cut through the air with such speed that the pressure produced by the swing blasted outward, and the sound of the attack reached Luke before the sword itself did as it came straight toward his face.
Luke merely shook his head.
’I wanted to have a normal fight, but I guess I’m just a cheat character.’
With that thought, he brought up the system information regarding Azrion, the Atlas Titan, specifically the second dormant ability that had awakened after his breakthrough to the Silver Knight stage.
[SECOND AWAKENING — UNLOCKED]
A dormant power belonging to the Titan Face
"AZRION" has awakened.
[AZRION’S UNWRITTEN ARTS]
Status: First Art Unlocked
[DESCRIPTION]
Azrion’s Unwritten Arts were created by Azrion himself after his natural Titan body size reached its physical limit.
His strength could continue surpassing the limits of most Titans and even contend with cosmic existences, but the size of his natural body remained restricted.
Rather than accepting this limitation, Azrion developed a method of externalizing his own force and shaping it into additional parts of his body.
These manifestations retain Azrion’s physical traits and allow him to construct a body far larger than his original form.
The ultimate purpose of the Unwritten Arts is to create a body capable of carrying what even Azrion’s natural body cannot.
THE UNIVERSE.
Luke stared at the description for a moment before inwardly sighing.
’Each Titan is a maniac.’

Seriously, all of them seemed determined to attempt something impossible. As a mortal himself, the very idea of Azrion creating a body capable of carrying the universe had sounded too absurd to even consider, and even now, after becoming a Titan himself, Luke still found Azrion’s obsession difficult to understand.
Rather than think about it any further, he moved on to the ability that had actually been unlocked.
[FIRST ART]: "HEAVEN’S PALM"
Luke immediately used the art.
He called upon the energy belonging to the Atlas Titan, which he now understood was essentially called *force*, and gathered it within his body before directing it outward through Heaven’s Palm.
RUMBLE!!!

The moment he activated the technique, the sky above the arena darkened as though an eclipse had suddenly descended over the battlefield, blocking the lights that had previously illuminated the entire area.
The change was so noticeable that the spectators immediately looked upward.
Marrec, however, didn’t care.
He continued increasing the force behind his downward swing, his Infernal Greatsword still heading toward Luke’s face.
Then everyone finally saw what had caused the darkness.
A gigantic spectral palm had formed above the arena.
The palm was made entirely from force, and although it was still descending slowly, its sheer size cast a vast shadow over the battlefield.
The expressions of the spectators immediately changed.
Even Peiro looked genuinely surprised.
A single question seemed to arise in everyone’s mind.
’How could someone produce an attack of this level without reaching the corresponding rank?’
The answer was directly above them.
The Heaven’s Palm continued descending.
Zeyr’s mouth twitched. "Is he really D-rank? Not A-rank?"

He could feel the power contained within the spectral palm, and from his perception, its strength had already reached the level of a High B-rank attack, a level that only Brynessa among the current contestants should have been able to stop directly.
Nolan stared upward with his mouth slightly open.
"If I told anyone about this outside, they’d probably make fun of me. How can an Early D-rank summon an attack at High B-rank level?"
Behind him, Arwen wiped away the sweat that had suddenly formed on his forehead.
"I shouldn’t provoke this monster anymore." The thought alone made him uneasy, but another thought soon followed.
’Does Her Highness even know how strong her husband is?’
He quickly remembered that Elaria was even stronger than Luke.
That realization relieved him somewhat.
In the end, Luke was still weaker than his own wife.
Meanwhile, Alia’s expression became increasingly excited as she watched Luke.
"Yes. He will be my partner. Only he is perfect for my partner."
Her body trembled slightly at the thought.
Originally, she had only wanted Luke to become her cauldron, someone whose energy could help her grow stronger over a certain period.
But after seeing what he was capable of, that idea had changed.
Even if she spent one hundred years with Luke, she wasn’t sure she could completely suck him dry.
Fortunately for Luke, he couldn’t hear her thoughts because he was too busy showing off.
Selene, however, didn’t need to hear them.
Her eyes twitched as she looked toward Alia.
’This vixen is thinking something bad about my husband again.’
Her teeth clenched slightly.
’I should lock Luke up so no other vixen can get close to him.’
She had already made up her mind.
Once this arena fight was finally over, she would find a way to keep her husband with her for eternity.
"Hehe~"
At that thought, a smile gradually spread across her lips, and her fangs also slipped out as she thought about it.
Estelle, sitting nearby, couldn’t help flinching when she noticed the strange behavior of both Alia and Selene.
Still, none of that could change the fact that Luke had become someone no one could ignore anymore.
With only D-rank cultivation, he could already produce an attack at High B-rank level.
Then what would happen when he reached C-rank?
And after that, B-rank?
Estelle’s heart began beating faster as she considered the possibilities.
’Could Luke eventually fight an S-rank being?’
’A King-tier existence?’
If he could, then by the time he reached that level, wouldn’t his personal strength approach the King tier as well, placing him only below the Emperor level?
The thought excited her.
She had to find a way to bring Luke closer to the Sunborn Kingdom.

Perhaps she could even make him fall in love with her and use that relationship to tie him to the kingdom, because a person like Luke could provide enormous benefits to both her and the entire kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Even Brynessa Realizes They Underestimated Luke!
paragraphs: Isaria, however, was thinking in the opposite direction.
’Luke has become so strong.’ She looked at him quietly.
’Would he still care about me? Would he even want to talk to me anymore?’
The thought made her feel increasingly distant from him.
She was only an Early C-rank.
And now, his world seemed to be moving farther away from hers, and for a moment, Isaria couldn’t help feeling that she might be looking at him for the last time.
"Luke..." So, his name escaped her lips in a low whisper.
Around the spectator seats, everyone had begun forming their own thoughts, plans, and conclusions about the hero who had just revealed another layer of his strength.
Then Luke finally brought the Heaven’s Palm down.
"COME DOWN!"
His shout echoed across the arena.
The spectral palm descended with greater force, and the pressure beneath it increased sharply.
Marrec’s body was driven downward.
The enormous force pressing against him felt as though a mountain had suddenly been placed above his head, forcing him toward the ground.
"NO!"
Marrec roared as he resisted.
"DON’T UNDERESTIMATE ME!"
With that shout, the two miniature suns floating behind his Battle Form immediately moved upward.
They streaked toward the descending palm before colliding directly with its surface.
BOOOOM!
BOOOOM!
Two explosions erupted almost simultaneously across the spectral hand, the blasts spreading across its surface and creating brief mushroom-shaped clouds.
For a moment, Marrec seemed to believe the attack had worked.
Then—
WHOOSH!
The Heaven’s Palm continued descending.
The force of its movement pushed the smoke and debris away from its surface, revealing that the two explosions had caused no meaningful damage.
Marrec’s expression stiffened.
"It’s futile, Marrec." Luke’s calm voice came.
"That palm is made of force, and force governs natural laws."
Even Luke was somewhat surprised by the structure and durability of the technique.
Azrion’s Unwritten Arts didn’t simply make an ordinary attack larger. They manifested the Titan’s physical traits through externalized force and gave those traits form.
There was, however, a serious problem.
When Luke had first tested Heaven’s Palm, he had discovered that it consumed almost all of the force stored within his body.
Ninety-nine percent.
His natural supply of force had barely been enough to maintain the technique.
To solve that problem, Luke had used Form Assimilation to replace Azrion’s heart within his current form with the Cosmic Heart.
The result had been significant.
The Cosmic Heart could pump a tremendous amount of force energy throughout his body, allowing Luke to maintain Heaven’s Palm without letting the manifestation collapse and disperse back into nature.
Without that additional supply, the enormous palm wouldn’t remain stable for long.
Down in the arena, Marrec continued struggling against the pressure.
His massive body was being pushed toward the ground, and despite all the force he exerted, he couldn’t properly move.
It was as though he were trapped beneath a mountain.
Eventually, Marrec stopped trying to force his way upward and allowed his body to endure the pressure while he looked toward Luke.
"Don’t think, hero, that your attack can defeat me!"
He still refused to back down.
"A real High B-rank attack is something you could never produce, because you’re not a real High B-rank!"
The words were clearly directed at Luke’s apparent cultivation.
Marrec had fought Brynessa before.
He knew what a genuine High B-rank was capable of.
Luke’s cultivation did not match that level, which made Marrec believe that there had to be a limit to whatever technique he was using.
So, instead of panicking, he waited.
Meanwhile, on Brynessa’s side, Mella continued watching the descending Heaven’s Palm with curiosity.
"Miss, has Luke’s Heaven’s Palm really reached the High B-rank level?"
Brynessa’s gaze remained fixed on the attack as she considered the question.
"Mella, the type of attack Luke is using is called Manifestation."
Mella listened carefully.
"Only A-rank beings can normally perform Manifestation, or unless a being possess a special Origin Skill or another ability that can produce a similar effect."
Mella’s expression immediately changed.

She had spent most of her time beside Brynessa, especially after Brynessa’s return, and although she had previously been within the Beast Empire, she had never personally witnessed a proper A-rank battle.
She had heard the rumors.
According to them, when A-rank beings truly fought, the shockwaves alone could overturn mountains.
The difference in destructive scale also showed just how far apart the ranks were.
An A-rank attack could reach a destructive area of around one hundred kilometers.
Even Peak B-rank beings normally reached around ten kilometers, while particularly powerful individuals could reach as far as twenty kilometers.
The difference was obvious.
Brynessa continued speaking calmly.
"From what I can see, Luke’s attack can be considered High B-rank in terms of outward power."
She narrowed her eyes.
"But his foundation isn’t that of a true High B-rank, and the manifestation itself is still incomplete.
She had already identified the weakness.
If Luke heard her explanation, he would have agreed.
Most of his problems still came back to one issue.
The quality of his energy.
His stat buffs increased the quantity of energy he possessed, not its fundamental quality.
At present, Luke was using genuine elements, but their quality remained around Silver level.
Even so, those genuine elements gave him an unusual advantage.
Many B-rank beings relied upon increasingly refined Essence and used it to imitate elemental properties, whereas Luke was using actual elemental energy, even if its quality was still low.
As a result, his attacks could still reach B-rank levels despite the weakness in his energy quality.
That was one of the reasons his current power was so strange.
Luke himself had already come to understand this.
If he were Early B-rank, his energy would also possess genuine B-rank quality, and the difference would be tremendous.
He could potentially erase Marrec with far simpler abilities instead of relying on complicated methods to bridge the gap.
Even reaching C-rank energy quality would help significantly.
After becoming a Titan, Luke had also learned something else.
His energy system would not advance exactly like that of ordinary cultivators.
Other beings eventually stopped using Aether and began using Essence, but Luke’s Titan forms were fundamentally different.
From the beginning, his Titan forms had used a mixture of Aether and genuine elemental energy.
After he became a true Titan, even his titan form only used real elemental energy.
Thinking about it, Luke released an annoyed breath.
"Whatever."
He raised his hands.
Then he summoned two more clones.
The new figures appeared beside him, still relatively small compared with his current seventy-foot form, but their bodies began expanding almost immediately.
The transformation continued until they reached the same size and appearance as Luke, complete with the white Nullex armor covering their bodies.
"Normally I don’t use much force than necessary, but this time, I am pissed off." Hearing Luke’s annoyed voice, A bad feeling immediately formed within Marrec.
He was not the only one.
The spectators also began to realize what Luke was preparing to do.
"It can’t be."
"That’s too broken."
"He’s dead."
Even Brynessa’s mouth twitched.
If Luke actually managed to use the same technique through all three bodies, then his threat level would rise dramatically.
Which means, they had clearly underestimated him.

’Would he still care about me?
Would he even want to talk to me anymore?’
The thought made her feel increasingly distant from him.
She was only an Early C-rank.

"Luke..." So, his name escaped her lips in a low whisper.

Ninety-nine percent.
His natural supply of force had barely been enough to maintain the technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 313: The Hero’s Forbidden Authority Finally Appears!
paragraphs: Down there, Luke calmly looked toward Marrec.
"So it’s your fault, Marrec." With those words, the other two Vorthars raised their hands.
"Heaven’s Palm!"
The ability was activated twice.
The sky darkened once again.
Two additional spectral palms appeared on either side of the original one, creating a triangular formation around Marrec as all three descended from different directions.
"WHATT!!!"
The spectators rose from their seats.
Even those who had already witnessed Luke’s abnormal strength couldn’t hide their shock this time.
Brynessa’s eyes widened.
Selene’s expression also changed as she finally felt the threat represented by the three descending palms.
The palms were still spectral.
But then their color began to change.
They turned black.
"Black-colored palms..."
Black, because, Luke had used Nyx’s third ability.
His Forbidden Authority.
Authority of Severance.
The three manifestations now carried both energy severance and physical severance.
That changed their danger completely.
Even a Peak B-rank couldn’t simply stand there and receive such an attack without consequence.
Peiro’s mouth opened slightly.
"What a monster."
He could sense that the raw destructive power of Luke’s Heaven’s Palm itself had not yet reached true Peak B-rank level.
But the addition of Forbidden Authority changed that.
Even in its current weakened state, the authority made the attack dangerous enough that a Peak B-rank would be forced to take it seriously.
"That’s why Forbidden Authority shouldn’t be used."
Peiro looked at the arena.
If he hadn’t reinforced it beforehand, he was certain that the whole battlefield itself would be destroyed and the attack would continue into the dark walls beyond it.
Yet another question appeared in his mind.
"How is his body not breaking apart?"
His gaze remained fixed on the three Lukes.
He could clearly sense the backlash generated by the techniques.
Yet all three of them remained standing calmly.
Luke’s body showed no obvious sign of collapse.
Peiro didn’t know anything about the Atlas Titan.
He didn’t know that Azrion’s body had been created specifically to bear forces that ordinary bodies couldn’t withstand.
That was exactly why Luke had grown so fond of this Titan.
Even though, it wasn’t a pure Titan, but its physique was suited for carrying the impossible weight.
Still, Luke should have been struggling under the backlash of these techniques.
Instead, his current fusion form had given his body a foundation that could theoretically carry something as absurd as the endless Void itself at its peak.
That meant its ability to endure backlash was equally abnormal.
Perhaps Luke could even force his current form to withstand the backlash of a Half-A-rank attack.
But an actual A-rank attack was still beyond him.
So, not that anyone would find out yet.
Since, Luke simply didn’t possess enough energy to produce a genuine Half-A-rank attack in the first place.
Below, the three Heaven’s Palms continued their descent.
Then Luke’s pissed-off voice, but confident voice, rang out throughout the arena, like the Void itself letting everyone present here know what he said.
"I don’t need my attack to compare to a real attack."
He looked directly toward Marrec.
"I have enough methods to make my attack stronger than real attacks."
This time, nobody could deny his statement.
Even Marrec stared upward with widened eyes.
Something was wrong with those three attacks.
He didn’t know whether his Essentification could withstand the combination of forces contained within them.
The raw power was one thing.
But that strange felling was another.
If those palms touched him, there was a possibility that his Essentification ability could be disrupted.
And if that happened, he would die.
The three palms drew closer and the pressure became heavier.
Marrec’s body was already being forced downward by the combined weight of the attacks, and he finally understood that continuing to gamble would be foolish.
So, he shouted toward Peiro.
"Lord Peiro!"
His voice strained against the pressure.
"I SURRENDER!"
The moment those words escaped his mouth, his body disappeared.
Space rippled.
Wrrr...
Marrec was teleported out of the area just before the three Heaven’s Palms reached him.
The next instant, he reappeared at a safe position within the arena.
He turned immediately.
What he saw left even him stunned.
The three Heaven’s Palms collided with the Peak B-rank arena at the same time.
Although two had appeared slightly later, they had synchronized their descent perfectly.
The impact struck with the force of a nuclear explosion.
BOOOOOOOOOO!
The arena floor shattered beneath them.
The destruction spread outward as broken earth and stone were torn apart by the impact.
The shockwave surged across the battlefield.
It reached the arena barrier.
BOOM!
The barrier rippled violently.
Wave after wave moved across its surface as the protective structure absorbed the force.
For a brief moment, it looked as though the barrier itself might break.
Another fraction of force and it might have happened.
But it held.
The destruction inside the arena was severe enough without that.
A huge cloud of dust rose from the center.
Visibility disappeared beneath the debris.
Peiro raised one hand.
A strong wind swept through the arena.
WHOOOSH!
The dust cloud began dispersing.
Slowly, the battlefield became visible again.
The center had been destroyed across an area roughly ten kilometers wide.
A massive pit had formed where the arena floor had once been.
At the bottom, no ordinary ground could be seen.
Only darkness remained.
Luke was floating above the destroyed area, using force to keep himself suspended.
Peiro also stared downward.
For some reason, the two of them were looking at the same thing.
The others, however, couldn’t understand what had caught their attention.
To them, the destruction itself was already more than enough.
Then a strange sound emerged from below.
CRICK—
CRACK!
It sounded almost like glass slowly breaking.
The spectators looked toward the pit.
Thin black lines began spreading across the damaged ground.
They weren’t ordinary cracks.
The ten-kilometer-wide area that had already been destroyed began to change again as the fractured ground started separating from itself.
The earth broke apart in sections, forming a strange pattern as though an enormous piece of glass had been shattered from beneath.
The pit began hollowing further, while the dark lines continued spreading.
Peiro’s expression slowly changed.
"Forbidden Authority."
The words escaped his mouth quietly.
He had not seen genuine Forbidden Authority being used like this for a long time.
Even though Luke’s current mastery of it was weak, the nature of the ability was unmistakable.
The others didn’t understand.
They assumed the strange phenomenon was simply another consequence of Luke’s attack aftermth.
Peiro knew better.
The destruction wasn’t stopping.
The Authority of Severance was continuing to work through the already damaged area, cutting deeper into the structure of the arena itself.
Marrec stared at the scene.
His throat moved as he swallowed.
For the first time since the battle had begun, genuine fear appeared on his face.
"Did the hero do this... because I provoked him?"
