chapters.title: Chapter 314: The Hero Just Destroyed a Mid-B-Rank and Went Back to Flirting!
paragraphs: "Winner! Luke Voidheart!"
Peiro’s voice echoed across the arena, finally breaking everyone out of the stunned expressions they had been wearing since the three Heaven’s Palms had descended.

Luke gave Peiro a small nod in acknowledgment before turning away and using Void Step to return to his specter seat, first allowing Valzareth to deactivate so that the armor disappeared from his body before he settled back into his normal form.
"Luke."
Selene’s face immediately brightened when she saw him return, and Luke couldn’t help smiling when he noticed how genuinely happy she looked.

He walked toward her, allowing the Titan transformation to fade completely until his ordinary appearance returned, and after the last traces of his armor disappeared, he stepped closer and wrapped his arms around her waist.
"So, how was your hubby’s performance?"
His tone carried a playful hint of pride as he looked at her.
The intimacy in his behavior caught Selene off guard, and a faint blush spread across her cheeks before she lowered her gaze.
"It was great."
Her answer came out in a soft whisper, and she immediately buried her face against his chest.
The surrounding representatives of Empyrean Academy, Estelle, Isaria, and the remaining warriors of the Sunborn Kingdom could only stare at the couple in bafflement.
The same man who had just summoned an attack powerful enough to threaten Peak B-rank beings was now standing there casually embracing his wife as though nothing particularly important had happened.
One of the female mages even covered her mouth with both hands.
"He just summoned a Peak B-rank-level attack, and now he’s sitting here chilling like it was no big deal?"
The disbelief in her voice was genuine.
Zeyr, however, gave a small laugh.
"Haha, it seems Luke is prideful, not arrogant."

He had witnessed Luke’s actions throughout the battle, and despite the ridiculous strength the hero had displayed, there hadn’t been the kind of deliberate arrogance that usually came from someone who had suddenly gained overwhelming power.

Several others nodded and began praising Luke as well, although Arwen and Larael chose to remain silent, both of them wishing, at least for the moment, that they could somehow become invisible and avoid being reminded of how badly they had underestimated him.
After a brief pause, Peiro’s voice came from above.
"Who will be the next contestant?"
The question immediately brought the attention of both groups back toward the arena.
Everyone except Luke and Selene, that was.
The couple remained absorbed in their own little world, paying almost no attention to the next battle, which made several people around them sigh helplessly.
Before anyone else could volunteer, however, Mella, Brynessa’s maid, stepped forward from the opposite side and jumped down into the arena.
"Seems like we have our new opponent here."
Karon spoke as she watched Mella descend, and without waiting for someone else to respond, she also jumped from the specter seat.
After witnessing Luke’s display of strength, she had developed an itch of her own to fight, and facing another combatant in the arena seemed like the best way to satisfy it.
"Fine."
Zeyr muttered as he settled back into his seat, while the others did the same and returned their attention to the battlefield.
Then a quiet complaint came from nearby, causing several mouths to twitch.
"Naughty boy, not now." Selene slapped Luke’s hand away.
His hand had been wandering toward her breast, and although the two were already married, she was still fully aware that they were surrounded by people.
Luke withdrew his hand without arguing.
From nearby, Nolan couldn’t resist commenting on the situation.
"Seems like Mr. Hero really loves his wives."
The moment those words escaped his mouth, Selene turned her head.
A deadly glare landed directly on Nolan.
Nolan froze. ’What?!’
Even Luke, who had been acting lovey-dovey a moment earlier, felt a bead of sweat form on his forehead.
He cautiously glanced toward Nolan.
’Bro, why are you mentioning wives? Can’t you see there’s only one present?’
He kept the thought to himself.
There was no way he was going to say it aloud.
Instead, Luke quietly tried to calm Selene’s slightly irritated mood while Nolan sat there wondering what exactly he had done wrong.
Meanwhile, the battle below had already begun.

Mella relied upon the wind element, while Karon fought using the shadow element, and the moment their abilities began to manifest, Zeyr narrowed his eyes slightly as he sensed something familiar within Mella’s power.
"Hmm, she seems to belong to the Wind Serpent lineage."

His observation made sense to him because he was a dragon, and dragons had a particularly close relationship with reptiles. There were even ancient myths claiming that reptilian species had originated from dragons breeding with other races, although modern dragons openly denied such stories, perhaps more because of the implications than because of any lack of evidence.
Kira, meanwhile, leaned forward as she watched the exchange intensify.
"Look, the fight is getting intense."
Her words drew everyone’s attention back toward the arena.
The two women had already transformed into their original forms.
Mella’s body stretched into a one-hundred-foot-long serpent, her cyan scales covering her entire body while two small horns protruded from her head.
The transformation also granted her the ability to fly, allowing her enormous serpent body to float through the arena’s sky as she stared at her opponent.
Across from her was an equally formidable dragon.
"Damn, I didn’t expect to see a dragon form here."
One of the Sunborn warriors couldn’t hide his surprise.
Karon had transformed into a one-hundred-foot-long Western-style dragon with horns, claws, a lean body, a long tail, and a pair of wings that stretched roughly two hundred feet from tip to tip.
The entirety of her body was black.
She looked like a dragon carved from the darkness itself.
"A Shadow Dragon."
Someone else muttered the identification under their breath.
Neither side wasted much time after completing their transformations.
Mella opened her jaws.
"Wind Cannon!"
A huge amount of Wind Essence immediately gathered within her mouth, spiraling inward as the surrounding air was pulled toward the center of the attack.
Karon responded almost immediately.

As a dragon, she possessed her own breath weapon, and she wasn’t willing to lose a contest of breath attacks simply because her opponent had chosen to attack from the air. Even though she could fly, but she wasn’t doing now.
"Dread Breath."
Her jaws opened. Darkness began gathering inside her mouth before she exhaled.
A concentrated torrent of shadow energy erupted forward.
Mella released her Wind Cannon at the same time.
The two attacks collided halfway between them.
BOOOOM!
The collision sent a violent tremor through the surrounding space.
Wind and shadow twisted against each other, neither side immediately giving way as the two women continued pouring energy into their respective attacks.
Wrrrrr...
Vmmmm...
Wrrrrr...
The sounds overlapped as the opposing energies fought for dominance.
The pressure between them kept building.
The ground far below began to suffer from the excess energy, portions of the arena floor being stripped away and vaporized as the collision continued.
Peiro had repaired the battlefield after Luke’s previous attack, but even this reinforced arena surface struggled to remain intact under the prolonged exchange.
As the attacks continued grinding against each other, faint fractures even began appearing in the surrounding space.
The concentration of energy had become so high that the area itself was starting to react.
Neither Mella nor Karon backed down.
Both were determined to overwhelm the other through sheer force.
For several seconds, the contest remained balanced.
Then Mella’s Wind Cannon began to weaken.
Her breathing became heavier as her attack power dropped.
Karon noticed it.
Her Dread Breath pressed forward.
The shadow torrent gradually forced the wind backward until it broke through the opposing attack.
BOOOM!
The Dread Breath finally collided with Mella’s enormous serpent body.
The impact sent her flying.
"Ahh!"
Her cry of pain echoed through the arena as her body twisted through the air.

sentences.text: "Winner!
Luke Voidheart!"
Peiro’s voice echoed across the arena, finally breaking everyone out of the stunned expressions they had been wearing since the three Heaven’s Palms had descended.

Luke gave Peiro a small nod in acknowledgment before turning away and using Void Step to return to his specter seat, first allowing Valzareth to deactivate so that the armor disappeared from his body before he settled back into his normal form.
"Luke."
Selene’s face immediately brightened when she saw him return, and Luke couldn’t help smiling when he noticed how genuinely happy she looked.

He walked toward her, allowing the Titan transformation to fade completely until his ordinary appearance returned, and after the last traces of his armor disappeared, he stepped closer and wrapped his arms around her waist.
"So, how was your hubby’s performance?"
His tone carried a playful hint of pride as he looked at her.
The intimacy in his behavior caught Selene off guard, and a faint blush spread across her cheeks before she lowered her gaze.
"It was great."
Her answer came out in a soft whisper, and she immediately buried her face against his chest.
The surrounding representatives of Empyrean Academy, Estelle, Isaria, and the remaining warriors of the Sunborn Kingdom could only stare at the couple in bafflement.
The same man who had just summoned an attack powerful enough to threaten Peak B-rank beings was now standing there casually embracing his wife as though nothing particularly important had happened.
One of the female mages even covered her mouth with both hands.
"He just summoned a Peak B-rank-level attack, and now he’s sitting here chilling like it was no big deal?"
The disbelief in her voice was genuine.
Zeyr, however, gave a small laugh.
"Haha, it seems Luke is prideful, not arrogant."

He had witnessed Luke’s actions throughout the battle, and despite the ridiculous strength the hero had displayed, there hadn’t been the kind of deliberate arrogance that usually came from someone who had suddenly gained overwhelming power.

Several others nodded and began praising Luke as well, although Arwen and Larael chose to remain silent, both of them wishing, at least for the moment, that they could somehow become invisible and avoid being reminded of how badly they had underestimated him.
After a brief pause, Peiro’s voice came from above.
"Who will be the next contestant?"
The question immediately brought the attention of both groups back toward the arena.
Everyone except Luke and Selene, that was.
The couple remained absorbed in their own little world, paying almost no attention to the next battle, which made several people around them sigh helplessly.
Before anyone else could volunteer, however, Mella, Brynessa’s maid, stepped forward from the opposite side and jumped down into the arena.
"Seems like we have our new opponent here."
Karon spoke as she watched Mella descend, and without waiting for someone else to respond, she also jumped from the specter seat.
After witnessing Luke’s display of strength, she had developed an itch of her own to fight, and facing another combatant in the arena seemed like the best way to satisfy it.
"Fine."
Zeyr muttered as he settled back into his seat, while the others did the same and returned their attention to the battlefield.
Then a quiet complaint came from nearby, causing several mouths to twitch.
"Naughty boy, not now." Selene slapped Luke’s hand away.
His hand had been wandering toward her breast, and although the two were already married, she was still fully aware that they were surrounded by people.
Luke withdrew his hand without arguing.
From nearby, Nolan couldn’t resist commenting on the situation.
"Seems like Mr.
Hero really loves his wives."
The moment those words escaped his mouth, Selene turned her head.
A deadly glare landed directly on Nolan.
Nolan froze. ’What?!’
Even Luke, who had been acting lovey-dovey a moment earlier, felt a bead of sweat form on his forehead.
He cautiously glanced toward Nolan.
’Bro, why are you mentioning wives?
Can’t you see there’s only one present?’
He kept the thought to himself.
There was no way he was going to say it aloud.
Instead, Luke quietly tried to calm Selene’s slightly irritated mood while Nolan sat there wondering what exactly he had done wrong.
Meanwhile, the battle below had already begun.

Mella relied upon the wind element, while Karon fought using the shadow element, and the moment their abilities began to manifest, Zeyr narrowed his eyes slightly as he sensed something familiar within Mella’s power.
"Hmm, she seems to belong to the Wind Serpent lineage."
His observation made sense to him because he was a dragon, and dragons had a particularly close relationship with reptiles.

There were even ancient myths claiming that reptilian species had originated from dragons breeding with other races, although modern dragons openly denied such stories, perhaps more because of the implications than because of any lack of evidence.
Kira, meanwhile, leaned forward as she watched the exchange intensify.
"Look, the fight is getting intense."
Her words drew everyone’s attention back toward the arena.
The two women had already transformed into their original forms.
Mella’s body stretched into a one-hundred-foot-long serpent, her cyan scales covering her entire body while two small horns protruded from her head.
The transformation also granted her the ability to fly, allowing her enormous serpent body to float through the arena’s sky as she stared at her opponent.
Across from her was an equally formidable dragon.
"Damn, I didn’t expect to see a dragon form here."
One of the Sunborn warriors couldn’t hide his surprise.
Karon had transformed into a one-hundred-foot-long Western-style dragon with horns, claws, a lean body, a long tail, and a pair of wings that stretched roughly two hundred feet from tip to tip.
The entirety of her body was black.
She looked like a dragon carved from the darkness itself.
"A Shadow Dragon."
Someone else muttered the identification under their breath.
Neither side wasted much time after completing their transformations.
Mella opened her jaws.
"Wind Cannon!"
A huge amount of Wind Essence immediately gathered within her mouth, spiraling inward as the surrounding air was pulled toward the center of the attack.
Karon responded almost immediately.
As a dragon, she possessed her own breath weapon, and she wasn’t willing to lose a contest of breath attacks simply because her opponent had chosen to attack from the air.
Even though she could fly, but she wasn’t doing now.
"Dread Breath."
Her jaws opened.
Darkness began gathering inside her mouth before she exhaled.
A concentrated torrent of shadow energy erupted forward.
Mella released her Wind Cannon at the same time.
The two attacks collided halfway between them.
BOOOOM!
The collision sent a violent tremor through the surrounding space.
Wind and shadow twisted against each other, neither side immediately giving way as the two women continued pouring energy into their respective attacks.
Wrrrrr...
Vmmmm...
Wrrrrr...
The sounds overlapped as the opposing energies fought for dominance.
The pressure between them kept building.
The ground far below began to suffer from the excess energy, portions of the arena floor being stripped away and vaporized as the collision continued.
Peiro had repaired the battlefield after Luke’s previous attack, but even this reinforced arena surface struggled to remain intact under the prolonged exchange.
As the attacks continued grinding against each other, faint fractures even began appearing in the surrounding space.
The concentration of energy had become so high that the area itself was starting to react.
Neither Mella nor Karon backed down.
Both were determined to overwhelm the other through sheer force.
For several seconds, the contest remained balanced.
Then Mella’s Wind Cannon began to weaken.
Her breathing became heavier as her attack power dropped.
Karon noticed it.
Her Dread Breath pressed forward.
The shadow torrent gradually forced the wind backward until it broke through the opposing attack.
BOOOM!
The Dread Breath finally collided with Mella’s enormous serpent body.
The impact sent her flying.
"Ahh!"
Her cry of pain echoed through the arena as her body twisted through the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 315: The Shadow Dragon VS The Wind Serpent
paragraphs: Brynessa watched calmly.
It wasn’t because she didn’t care about Mella.
Quite the opposite.
She had ordered Mella not to waste her life here, and she trusted that her maid would surrender before the situation became fatal.
Marrec, standing nearby, watched the battle with a somewhat helpless expression.
"She seems to be struggling." He understood exactly why.
Dragons were not easy opponents, and Karon wasn’t some ordinary dragon.
She was a prodigy among her kind.
So it was only natural that Mella would struggle against her.
Brynessa’s voice followed from beside him.
"You would struggle as well if you faced either of these two dragons."
Marrec’s hand tightened into a fist.
He didn’t answer.
He knew she was telling the truth.

He had once been considered a prodigy himself, but another talented noble had become jealous of his potential and used his status and influence to have Marrec’s family executed while also attempting to kill him.
Marrec had escaped.
Afterward, he had become a fugitive and eventually joined the Infernal Choir because he needed the power and protection necessary to one day take revenge on that noble.
The thought remained buried inside him as he watched the battle.
Below, Mella and Karon resumed their exchange.
The serpent moved through the air, twisting around incoming attacks while attempting to strike with compressed wind.
Karon countered by using her wings to change direction and her shadow energy to obscure her movements.
The two bodies collided several times.
THOOM!
Mella’s tail struck Karon’s side.
The Shadow Dragon was pushed away, but she immediately recovered and snapped her jaws toward Mella.
Mella twisted aside.
The attack missed her neck but scraped along her scales, leaving a darkened wound.
At the same time, a blade of compressed wind cut across Karon’s wing.
She hissed and pulled away.
"Hahh..."
Mella’s breathing had become rough.
"Huff..."
Karon’s chest rose and fell more quickly as well.
Both had already consumed a considerable amount of stamina and Essence.
Neither looked willing to continue endlessly.
Then Mella spoke.
"Seems like it’s time to finish this."
Karon looked toward her and gave a slow nod.
Both understood what the other meant.
There was no reason to continue exchanging smaller attacks.
They would settle the battle with their strongest techniques.
Mella drew in a deep breath.
The surrounding wind immediately responded.
Air began rushing toward her body from all directions, gathering around her as the energy compressed tighter and tighter.
Karon’s shadow energy also began gathering above her.
The atmosphere darkened.
Then both women released their ultimate abilities.
"ULTIMATE INNATE ABILITY: STORM PIERCE!"
"ULTIMATE ABILITY: CRESCENT FALL!"
The wind around Mella compressed into a gigantic rotating spear.
Rather than spreading the force across a large area, nearly all of its destructive power was concentrated along the weapon’s length and focused toward the sharpened tip.
The wind surrounding the spear spiraled inward continuously, creating layers upon layers of compressed air that rotated so quickly that the space around it began to distort.
Once released, Storm Pierce would travel at tremendous speed, and the rotation would allow the attack to drill into powerful defenses instead of simply striking them with blunt force.
Unlike wide-area wind attacks, the technique sacrificed its range of effect in exchange for penetration and concentrated destruction.
Mella’s eyes narrowed.
"Go!"
She released the spear.
WHOOOSH!
The massive rotating spear tore through the air.
At almost the same moment, Karon completed her own technique.
A gigantic black crescent appeared above them.

The crescent remained suspended in the sky as large amounts of shadow energy gathered into it, its surface appearing almost completely devoid of light while dense darkness continued accumulating within its center.
Karon’s eyes remained fixed on Mella.
"Crescent Fall."
The energy within the crescent reached its limit.
The center suddenly opened.
A colossal beam of pure shadow erupted downward.
BOOOOM!
The beam descended directly toward Mella’s Storm Pierce.
Mella’s wind spear continued forward at full speed, the rotation becoming even faster as it met the incoming shadow beam.
The two attacks raced toward each other.
Neither side slowed.
The surrounding air twisted violently around them, while the ground beneath their path trembled under the pressure of the two concentrated techniques.
Storm Pierce was designed to pierce through defenses by focusing its destructive force into one point.
Crescent Fall, meanwhile, possessed tremendous destructive and penetrating power, capable of overwhelming magical defenses and annihilating whatever remained directly within its path.
Now the two ultimate attacks were about to collide.
And the next exchange would determine whose technique would break first.
"HOLY MOTHER!"

The sight of the two massive attacks, each stretching roughly one hundred meters, sent goosebumps across the bodies of the Sunborn warriors as they stared upward in disbelief. An attack of this scale could easily destroy an area of one kilometer, meaning that an ordinary city would have little chance of surviving if it were caught directly in their path.
"So she used it."

Zeyr calmly analyzed the two techniques while keeping his eyes fixed on the clash ahead, but after a moment, he shook his head because although Karon’s beam possessed excellent destructive power, along with its annihilating property and elemental advantage, something about Mella’s attack felt different.
He could sense it.
The Wind Spear was special.

In fact, it seemed that nearly all of Mella’s other abilities had been intentionally kept relatively weak because the greater portion of her bloodline power had been concentrated into this ultimate technique.
"Plus, that wind spear, judging by its name, seems to possess a piercing ability."
Zeyr narrowed his eyes as he continued analyzing the clash.
"That means there’s a high chance Mella will win this."
And his prediction proved correct.
BOOOOOM!
The instant the two ultimate attacks collided, a thunderous explosion tore across the arena as the shadow beam and the rotating wind spear pushed directly against each other.

The black beam continuously attempted to erase the wind spear beneath its tremendous destructive power, but instead of breaking apart, the spear kept drilling through it, its rotation allowing it to cut through the dense shadow energy as though it were slicing through soft butter.
The surrounding space trembled from the concentrated power of the two techniques.
Karon’s expression changed.
"THIS?!"
Her eyes widened as she watched her Dread Breath being pierced from within rather than simply overpowered.
She had never expected Mella’s ultimate ability to be this strong.
The wind spear continued advancing.
Its rotation never stopped.

Even as shadow energy consumed portions of its outer layer, the compressed wind immediately replaced them, maintaining the spear’s momentum until it finally broke through the remaining portion of Karon’s attack.
"Seems like my loss."
Karon gave a small sigh as she accepted the result.
The Storm Pierce finally crossed the remnants of the shadow beam and continued toward the gigantic black crescent suspended above them.
BOOOOOM!
The spear struck the crescent directly.
The black construct shattered under the impact, and the remaining wind energy scattered through the surrounding space as fragments of condensed shadow dispersed alongside it.
For several seconds, that portion of the arena was filled with violent wind currents and lingering streams of shadow energy, making it difficult to see either woman clearly.
Only after the opposing energies gradually dispersed did the spectators finally see Mella and Karon again, both of them having returned to their humanoid forms.
Karon’s expression had fallen.
She already knew what the result meant.
"I surrender."

There was no hesitation in her voice because she could feel that her energy had been almost completely exhausted, while Mella, despite being weakened from the previous exchanges, had clearly not used everything she possessed from the beginning.
’Maybe her ordinary abilities consume less energy, while her ultimate takes most of what she has.’
With that thought, Karon sighed before looking toward Peiro.
The blue spirit nodded.
"Winner: Mella. The Infernal Choir wins this round."
With the announcement, Karon was immediately transported back to the spectator seats.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: The Wind Spear That Pierced a Shadow Dragon Must Face a Mountain!
paragraphs: "You did great, Lady Karon."
Nolan and Kira tried to cheer her up when she appeared, but Karon merely nodded before returning to her seat.
Then, almost without meaning to, her gaze shifted toward Luke and Selene.

The two were sitting unusually close to one another again, and judging by the subtle movement of Luke’s hand between Selene’s legs, beneath their line of sight, they were clearly doing some shady things, while everyone else was focused on the battle.
’Seems like he still isn’t able to control himself.’
The thought made a faint smile appear on Karon’s face, and strangely enough, the sight of them helped ease some of the disappointment she had felt after losing.
"I’ll be done with this." Zeyr pushed himself up from his seat.
After seeing that the battle had reached this point, he decided it was finally his turn to enter the arena.
He stepped forward and jumped down.
Meanwhile, beside him, but far a quiet moan escaped Selene.
Luke had been trying to tease her by rubbing her gently between her legs, and although she had been trying to push his hand away, he had shown no intention of stopping.
"Luke, we can’t. I have a match coming."
Selene kept her voice low as she attempted to move his hand away again, but Luke’s lust had already increased, making her effort less effective than she wanted.
Hearing her words, Luke smiled playfully.
"Do you want me to beat her?"
Selene immediately shook her head.
"Nah, I can do that."
Luke was a monster when it came to his strange ways, but Selene was hardly any different in that regard.
More importantly, she and Brynessa were both B-rank beings, meaning that the difference between them wouldn’t be decided simply through Essence.
She possessed Emperor blood and it was flowing through her veins, and Selene believed she could raise her raw power enough to overwhelm Brynessa’s own.
Of course, she conveniently ignored one important detail.
Emperor blood also flowed through Brynessa’s veins.
Selene simply had too much confidence in her own Origin Skills, Vampire Innate Ability, and arts to let that concern her.
She possessed both.
One ultimate ability came from her racial ability, while the other originated from her Origin Skill.
That combination wasn’t unique among extremely powerful bloodlines, but it was especially common among the children of Emperors, which was one of the reasons such descendants were so formidable.
There was, however, one important difference in how those abilities awakened.
For an Emperor’s child, the Innate Ability would generally remain locked until reaching B-rank, while the Origin Skill was available from the beginning.
On Brynessa’s side, Marrec was still looking toward the arena with a somewhat surprised expression.
"She won."
He hadn’t expected Mella to defeat Karon with that ultimate ability, and even he had been caught off guard by the strength of Storm Pierce.
"Yeah." Brynessa answered calmly.
She didn’t seem surprised.
She had apparently expected Mella to achieve that result.
Down in the arena, the next battle began.
Zeyr transformed immediately.
His body shifted into the form of an Earth Dragon, and his already powerful frame expanded until a one-hundred-foot-long dragon stood in the arena.
He possessed four sturdy limbs supporting his body, but unlike many dragons of his kind, he had no wings.
Yet the first thing anyone noticed about him had nothing to do with his lack of wings.
"So muscular!"
His entire body was heavily built.

From his limbs to his neck and head, every section of his body was covered in dense muscle, giving him the appearance of something that would be extremely difficult to injure through physical attacks alone.
And there was another layer protecting those muscles.
Earth-like scales covered his entire body.
Mella standing in front of him, already aware that she was facing a difficult opponent.
Zeyr’s voice echoed through the arena.
"Miss, your spear’s piercing power is impressive, but against my defense, it will be futile."
His confidence wasn’t without reason.
He had already analyzed her ultimate ability, and while he acknowledged its penetration, he trusted the natural defensive capabilities of his Earth Dragon body even more.
"Rather than wasting time with smaller attacks, let’s use our ultimates."
The suggestion wasn’t simply a matter of pride.
Zeyr knew exactly where the battle stood.
He was still in perfect condition, while Mella had already spent a considerable amount of her energy fighting Karon.
If both of them used their strongest abilities immediately, the advantage naturally belonged to him.
"Okay."
Mella accepted.
Her body changed once again, transforming back into the one-hundred-foot-long Wind Serpent.
Zeyr also understood that there was another reason to use his ultimate instead of simply relying upon his defense.
Although he trusted that he could survive Storm Pierce, surviving didn’t mean he would come out unharmed.
He had no desire to take unnecessary injuries.
Both of them gathered their energy.
Then they activated their ultimate abilities at the same time.
"ULTIMATE INNATE ABILITY: STORM PIERCE!
"ULTIMATE ABILITY: MOUNTAINFORGED!"
Mella gathered the surrounding wind into another gigantic rotating spear.
The air around the weapon spiraled violently inward as layers of compressed wind formed around its body, concentrating almost all of its destructive force toward the tip.
The spear rotated continuously, and the pressure produced by its movement caused the surrounding air to twist and distort.
Across from her, Zeyr’s ultimate ability began taking shape.
His claws dug into the arena floor.
Then the surrounding earth responded.
Stone began rising around his body.
Minerals embedded within the ground were pulled upward, breaking free from the arena and flowing toward his dragon form.
The surrounding terrain didn’t simply surround him. It merged with him.
Layer after layer of earth, stone, and minerals fused with his scales, limbs, and tail, creating additional protection over his already powerful body.
The transformation continued as more of the surrounding terrain was incorporated into his form.
His body kept expanding.
The increase in size was gradual at first, then accelerated as more material joined the transformation.
Once it was complete, Zeyr was roughly five times larger than his original dragon form.
His draconic features remained recognizable beneath the layers of fused terrain, but his body had now become something far closer to a living mountain shaped into the form of a dragon.
He had become a five-hundred-foot-tall Earth Dragon.
Or, more accurately, a five-hundred-foot-tall mountain shaped like one.
If the system were present and examined his current condition, the result would have been:
[ MOUNTAINFORGED EFFECTS ]
Size: ×5
Strength: ×5
The enormous increase in mass, combined with the Earth energy fused into his body, increased Zeyr’s physical strength by five times.
Defense: ×50
The layers of fused earth, stone, and minerals dramatically increased Zeyr’s defensive power.
His physical defense became fifty times greater than his normal state, making his transformed body extraordinarily difficult to damage.
Speed: Significantly Reduced
The immense increase in size and weight severely affected Zeyr’s mobility.
His acceleration, turning speed, and ability to rapidly change direction were greatly reduced.

Luke was a monster when it came to his strange ways, but Selene was hardly any different in that regard.
More importantly, she and Brynessa were both B-rank beings, meaning that the difference between them wouldn’t be decided simply through Essence.
She possessed Emperor blood and it was flowing through her veins, and Selene believed she could raise her raw power enough to overwhelm Brynessa’s own.
Of course, she conveniently ignored one important detail.
Emperor blood also flowed through Brynessa’s veins.
Selene simply had too much confidence in her own Origin Skills, Vampire Innate Ability, and arts to let that concern her.
She possessed both.
One ultimate ability came from her racial ability, while the other originated from her Origin Skill.
That combination wasn’t unique among extremely powerful bloodlines, but it was especially common among the children of Emperors, which was one of the reasons such descendants were so formidable.
There was, however, one important difference in how those abilities awakened.
For an Emperor’s child, the Innate Ability would generally remain locked until reaching B-rank, while the Origin Skill was available from the beginning.
On Brynessa’s side, Marrec was still looking toward the arena with a somewhat surprised expression.
"She won."
He hadn’t expected Mella to defeat Karon with that ultimate ability, and even he had been caught off guard by the strength of Storm Pierce.
"Yeah." Brynessa answered calmly.
She didn’t seem surprised.
She had apparently expected Mella to achieve that result.
Down in the arena, the next battle began.
Zeyr transformed immediately.
His body shifted into the form of an Earth Dragon, and his already powerful frame expanded until a one-hundred-foot-long dragon stood in the arena.
He possessed four sturdy limbs supporting his body, but unlike many dragons of his kind, he had no wings.
Yet the first thing anyone noticed about him had nothing to do with his lack of wings.
"So muscular!"
His entire body was heavily built.

From his limbs to his neck and head, every section of his body was covered in dense muscle, giving him the appearance of something that would be extremely difficult to injure through physical attacks alone.
And there was another layer protecting those muscles.
Earth-like scales covered his entire body.
Mella standing in front of him, already aware that she was facing a difficult opponent.
Zeyr’s voice echoed through the arena.
"Miss, your spear’s piercing power is impressive, but against my defense, it will be futile."
His confidence wasn’t without reason.
He had already analyzed her ultimate ability, and while he acknowledged its penetration, he trusted the natural defensive capabilities of his Earth Dragon body even more.
"Rather than wasting time with smaller attacks, let’s use our ultimates."
The suggestion wasn’t simply a matter of pride.
Zeyr knew exactly where the battle stood.
He was still in perfect condition, while Mella had already spent a considerable amount of her energy fighting Karon.
If both of them used their strongest abilities immediately, the advantage naturally belonged to him.
"Okay."
Mella accepted.
Her body changed once again, transforming back into the one-hundred-foot-long Wind Serpent.
Zeyr also understood that there was another reason to use his ultimate instead of simply relying upon his defense.
Although he trusted that he could survive Storm Pierce, surviving didn’t mean he would come out unharmed.
He had no desire to take unnecessary injuries.
Both of them gathered their energy.
Then they activated their ultimate abilities at the same time.
"ULTIMATE INNATE ABILITY: STORM PIERCE!
"ULTIMATE ABILITY: MOUNTAINFORGED!"
Mella gathered the surrounding wind into another gigantic rotating spear.
The air around the weapon spiraled violently inward as layers of compressed wind formed around its body, concentrating almost all of its destructive force toward the tip.
The spear rotated continuously, and the pressure produced by its movement caused the surrounding air to twist and distort.
Across from her, Zeyr’s ultimate ability began taking shape.
His claws dug into the arena floor.
Then the surrounding earth responded.
Stone began rising around his body.
Minerals embedded within the ground were pulled upward, breaking free from the arena and flowing toward his dragon form.
The surrounding terrain didn’t simply surround him.
It merged with him.
Layer after layer of earth, stone, and minerals fused with his scales, limbs, and tail, creating additional protection over his already powerful body.
The transformation continued as more of the surrounding terrain was incorporated into his form.
His body kept expanding.
The increase in size was gradual at first, then accelerated as more material joined the transformation.
Once it was complete, Zeyr was roughly five times larger than his original dragon form.
His draconic features remained recognizable beneath the layers of fused terrain, but his body had now become something far closer to a living mountain shaped into the form of a dragon.
He had become a five-hundred-foot-tall Earth Dragon.
Or, more accurately, a five-hundred-foot-tall mountain shaped like one.
If the system were present and examined his current condition, the result would have been:
[ MOUNTAINFORGED EFFECTS ]
Size: ×5
Strength: ×5
The enormous increase in mass, combined with the Earth energy fused into his body, increased Zeyr’s physical strength by five times.
Defense: ×50
The layers of fused earth, stone, and minerals dramatically increased Zeyr’s defensive power.
His physical defense became fifty times greater than his normal state, making his transformed body extraordinarily difficult to damage.
Speed: Significantly Reduced
The immense increase in size and weight severely affected Zeyr’s mobility.
His acceleration, turning speed, and ability to rapidly change direction were greatly reduced.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Three Women Fight Over Luke’s Empty Seat!
paragraphs: "THIS IS CRAZY!"

All the Sunborn warriors stared in disbelief at Zeyr’s enormous new form. Creating a huge-sized attack was one thing, something Luke had already demonstrated earlier, but transforming one’s entire body into such a gigantic size was an entirely different matter.
"Show-off," Karon muttered, while the other Empyrean representatives could only stare at Zeyr with speechless expressions.
Zeyr had always enjoyed displaying his strength, and apparently, this was simply another opportunity for him to do so.
Meanwhile, Marrec’s mouth had fallen completely open.
"Is this what an early B-rank can become?"

"For an Earth Dragon, yes," Brynessa answered calmly, having already seen Earth Dragons of even greater size before. After all, the bodies of the ancient Earth Dragons were practically walking mountains.
Hearing that, Marrec became even more shocked, and his attention quickly shifted toward Mella.
"Now I don’t even know whether her Wind Spear can pierce his body or not."
Brynessa didn’t answer. As she already knew the result.
"COME!"
Zeyr’s thunderous roar spread across the arena as Mella, without the slightest change in expression, she released her rotating Wind Spear directly toward the back of his mountain-like form.
WHOOOOOSH!
The gigantic spear tore through the air, spinning at tremendous speed as layers of compressed wind twisted around its tip.
"ROAR!"

Zeyr suddenly turned around and faced the incoming attack head-on. Instead of avoiding it, he deliberately took the attack directly, clearly intending to demonstrate just how strong his defense had become after activating Mountainforged.
BAAANG!
The collision sounded like a gigantic cannon had exploded inside the arena.
The impact blasted stones from Zeyr’s head and sent dust and fragments flying in every direction, yet what happened next left the Sunborn warriors completely stunned.
"NO WAY!"

Mella’s Wind Spear continued spinning furiously against Zeyr’s dragon head, grinding against his hardened body as sparks flew in every direction. Dust filled the surrounding air, and the wind screamed around the point of impact, but despite all that force, the spear simply could not penetrate his defense.
It had managed to push forward during the initial impact, but after that, it had stopped completely.
Not even a shallow wound remained.
Zeyr’s defense had simply held.
Mella stared at the scene for a moment before letting out a quiet sigh. Without wasting any further energy, she withdrew the Wind Spear and returned to her humanoid form.
"You win." She surrendered immediately, not even waiting for Peiro to formally announce anything.
Zeyr’s mouth twitched.
"Women nowadays..."
His gaze shifted toward Brynessa, and the playful expression on his face disappeared as fighting spirit began to rise within his eyes.
"Zeyr won. The Sunborn side wins this round," Peiro announced calmly.
There was hardly any change in his expression, just as there had been during the other battles.
The only time Peiro had shown an obvious reaction was during Luke’s battle.
After all, everyone fighting in this arena had been within roughly the same realm.
Luke had been different.
He had fought opponents two realms above his own and overwhelmed them.
If something like that failed to draw a reaction from Peiro, what possibly could?
Meanwhile, Mella lowered her head toward Brynessa.
"I am sorry, Miss. I lost."
There was genuine disappointment in her voice. If Brynessa hadn’t ordered her earlier not to fight to the death, Mella would have continued fighting until one of them could no longer stand.
"It’s fine," Brynessa replied calmly.
She rose from her seat and removed her black robe completely, revealing her full appearance to everyone watching.
Underneath was a royal green robe decorated with intricate designs that further emphasized her status.
Without another word, Brynessa stepped forward and jumped down into the arena, landing directly in front of Zeyr.
"She is finally here!"
"A High B-rank!"
The atmosphere immediately became tense, yet excitement also spread throughout the spectators.
This was the first time a true High B-rank combatant had entered the arena, which meant they were finally about to witness a battle between beings at a much higher level.

Of course, Luke’s previous display of strength wasn’t necessarily something that could be repeated endlessly. A High B-rank could unleash attacks of that level repeatedly, while a lower-ranked combatant might only be able to produce one or two such attacks before exhausting themselves.
Even Luke and Selene turned their attention toward the arena.
They both wanted to see exactly what Zeyr could bring out now that he was facing a High B-rank opponent.
"Start," Peiro announced.
Zeyr immediately looked toward Brynessa with complete confidence.
"Even though you are a High B-rank, I am sure you can’t move my Mountainforged form."
"Oh? Really?" Brynessa smiled.
Under the stunned gazes of everyone present, her body suddenly began to transform.

Her small humanoid form expanded rapidly, stretching upward and outward like a snake escaping from a confined space. Her body continued growing longer and larger until the transformation finally revealed her true royal serpent form.
A thousand-foot-long royal serpent now occupied the arena.
Unlike Mella’s Wind Serpent form, whose head retained the distinct triangular shape of a true snake.

She resembled a giant royal cobra, with the sides of her head expanded outward like a hood. Two fully grown purple horns emerged from the top of her head, curving backward like the horns of an Eastern dragon.

Four limbs were present along the beginning and end portions of her enormous serpentine body. They were relatively small compared to the rest of her body, but perfectly suited for gripping or attacking.
Her entire body was covered in a beautiful mixture of purple and green scales that shimmered under the arena’s light.
Zeyr stared at her.
The confidence on his face disappeared.
"This..."
He suddenly felt that he had spoken far too early.
’I am fucked.’ That was the only thought left in his mind.
Brynessa didn’t give him time to recover.
Her enormous tail swept sideways.
The movement was so fast that the sound barrier itself seemed to break around it.
SHHHWOOOOOSH!!!
FWWWWOOOM!!!
THOOOOOM!!!
BOOOOOM!!!
Her tail struck Zeyr’s mountain-like dragon body directly.
For one brief instant, Zeyr’s gigantic form appeared frozen in place.
Then his body bent inward from the impact.
The next moment, his entire five-hundred-foot body was blasted backward with terrifying speed, crossing the arena almost instantly before crashing into the ground nearly twenty kilometers away.
BOOOOM!
The impact created a gigantic crater.

The earth within a kilometer radius was completely destroyed as soil and shattered stone erupted into the air. Zeyr’s enormous body remained buried deep inside the crater, and for several seconds, there was no movement at all.
The spectators fell silent.
Everyone had just witnessed something difficult to process.
Zeyr had always been one of the clearest examples of overwhelming physical strength and defense among the Emperyan warriors.
Yet a single flick of Brynessa’s tail had sent him flying across the arena.
And she had done it effortlessly.
"Can we even defeat her?"
"We can’t..."
The Sunborn warriors exchanged tense whispers, their gazes repeatedly shifting between Brynessa and the spectator seats where Luke and Selene were sitting.
At this point, they could only think of those monsters when it came to fighting another monster.
As those thoughts spread through the crowd, a painful voice finally emerged from the distant crater.
"U-Ugh..."
Zeyr’s voice was barely audible.
"I surrender!
His entire body was injured, nearly every bone broken from the impact. Even moving his jaw had become difficult.
"Brynessa won. Infernal side wins," Peiro announced.
With that, Zeyr’s body was immediately transported back into the spectator seats, where his gigantic form reverted to his normal body.
He appeared in a half-dead state.
"You should stop showing off already," Karon muttered with a sigh.
She immediately fed Zeyr a High-rank B-grade healing potion.
"Ughh..." Instead of a proper response, Zeyr could only produce a painful grunt.
Even with his powerful physique, his potent Essence, and the healing potion, repairing every damaged bone and muscle would still take several hours.
Peiro then turned his attention toward Luke and Selene.
"Send your next warrior."
"I have to go, honey."
Selene slapped his hand away, which was all the time present between her legs, and gave him a shameless look before standing up.
Luke’s expression remained perfectly composed.
He still wore the innocent face of a husband who had absolutely nothing to do with whatever had just happened.
"Shameless," Selene muttered upon seeing that expression.
She then jumped into the arena, crossing the distance and reaching the center almost instantly.
"The final battle, I guess," one of the Empyrean Academy representatives remarked.
Everyone knew Selene wasn’t weak. She had already defeated a Mid-B-rank opponent before, but she had never publicly fought against a High B-rank.
That was about to change.
Meanwhile, the moment three women noticed that Luke was sitting alone and that the sticky vampire had finally left, their eyes immediately lit up.
Alia, Estelle, and Isaria stood up at almost the exact same time.
Rustle! Rustle! Rustle!
The moment they noticed one another, their expressions changed.
None of them had any intention of giving up their chance.
All three immediately rushed toward Luke’s seat.
Tap! Tap! Tap!
THUD! THUD! THUD!
On the way, Nolan and Arwen were suddenly knocked backward into their seats as Alia and Estelle passed them without slowing down.
Both of them stared after the women in confusion.
"What the hell just happened?"
But none of the three women cared.
They finally reached Luke’s seat and immediately took their places beside him.
Plop! Plop!
Only two distinct sounds came from the seats.
Alia and Estelle had already occupied Luke’s left and right sides.
As for Isaria...
"I am sorry..." She whispered shyly, because she was sitting at Luke’s center, between his legs.
The moment everyone noticed where she had positioned herself, their expressions became strange.
Alia and Estelle and even others would notice this, and felt this womanizer couldn’t control his lust; just as his wife went, he targeted another woman.
"It’s ok." Luke said with a saintly face, but there, Isaria could feel that Luke’s third brother was poking her.
Which she misunderstood, thinking he still got physically attracted to her.
But the truth for hardness of his little brother was far more embarrassing for Luke.
Selene had only just left, and he had not yet completely recovered from their earlier intimacy.
So now he could do nothing except maintain a perfectly normal expression and pretend that nothing unusual was happening.
’I just hope Selene doesn’t turn around.’ Luke silently prayed while keeping his face completely composed.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Selene’s Smile Terrifies Luke!
paragraphs: [You sure are enjoying yourself, Luke. 😊👏 Keep going.]
’You know, it’s not me who went to them; they came here by themselves!’ Luke defended himself internally, unwilling to let the System gain the upper hand.

Unfortunately for him, the System had already gained plenty of experience dealing with situations like this. It specialized in creating healthy yandere-like chaos, so how could a mere newborn Titan possibly defeat it?
[Heh~ I am sure, the thing poking down at Isaria A*s, if enter now. She wouldn’t mind, hell, I am 100% sure, that all these three women wouldn’t mind your thing inside.]
[Just look at their expressions! They’re practically thirsty. You should fill them, Luke!]
Luke’s mouth twitched.
Slowly, he turned his head to look at the women beside him.
The System wasn’t wrong.
Alia was still staring downward at his hard little brother with an almost fascinated expression, a little drool escaping from the corner of her mouth as she watched the situation unfold.
Estelle, meanwhile, was staring at Luke’s free hand. She looked as though she wanted to hold it, yet she kept hesitating, unable to decide whether she should actually do it.
Luke immediately began regretting every decision that had brought him to this point.
’If you want me dead, just tell me directly. There is no need to come up with elaborate methods of torture.’
He firmly rejected the System’s suggestion with the determination of a loyal husband.
For a brief moment, the System went silent.
Luke almost felt relieved.
But that relief lasted only a moment before the System’s playful voice returned.
[Luke, look! Your wife Selene is looking at you with a happy smile. She’s even encouraging you to continue. ヽ(•‿•)ノ]
"o_o"
Luke’s entire mind seemed to freeze.
’Selene?!’
Suppressing the ominous feeling spreading through his body, he slowly looked forward, desperately hoping the System was simply messing with him.
But—
There she was.
Selene was genuinely looking toward him with a smile, her fangs clearly visible as she raised one hand and gave him a cheerful little wave.
Luke’s expression didn’t change.
But internally, his soul had already left his body.
He knew that smile.
That wasn’t a smile of happiness.
That was the smile of his impending doom.
Selene said something from across the spectator seats, her expression remaining perfectly pleasant.
Luke couldn’t hear her voice from this distance, yet somehow, he could still understand what she had said by reading her lips.
"My darling, sure having so much fun~"
’I am cooked!’
’I am absolutely cooked!’
’No, I’m beyond cooked!’
Luke felt as though his future had already been decided.
Even his little brother, who was proudly standing and kept poking at Isaria’s A*s, like it was finding any hole to enter, which his big brother was not helping with.
Suddenly, he felt he lost all his power, and it started shrinking at an alarming speed.
Noticing this, If it could speak, its panic-filled voice would probably have echoed throughout the entire arena.
"NO! I haven’t completed my mission yet! All I want! Just a small HOLE!"
"A small hole! Which I would make big by myself!!"
"Wait! I only need one tiny chance!"
"Just a little more!"
"NOOOO!"
Unfortunately, Luke couldn’t hear any of it.
He was already slumped deep into his chair like a man whose soul had been separated from his body, his mind completely consumed by thoughts of the impending doom that awaited him.
The System, somehow, could hear everything. Like a childhood friend.
[Poor little brother.]
And the System pity him.
Its grand scheme had failed before it could reach its conclusion.
Meanwhile, none of the three women had noticed Selene’s terrifying gaze.
Alia’s attention was still fixed on Luke’s little brother, although her previous fascination gradually disappeared as she noticed changing, that Luke’s little brother was dying.
’Why?’
Confusion appeared on her face.
The drool at the corner of her mouth stopped, and she tilted her head slightly as she wondered why the thing she had been watching seemed to be losing its previous vigor.
Isaria noticed the same thing.
She could feel the awkward pressure against her as* gradually disappearing, and to her own surprise, a strange sense of disappointment surfaced within her.
’What?’
’Why am I disappointed?’
She couldn’t understand her own reaction, and before she could even begin sorting through those confusing thoughts, the source of them completely retreated.
The little brother got completely shut down, as Luke’s body decided that it would not be able to stand again.
After all, Luke wasn’t even sure whether his little brother would survive what was waiting for him, much less whether he himself would survive Selene afterward.
At the same time, Estelle finally saw her opportunity.
Luke had slumped deeper into his chair, completely defeated by his own thoughts, and his right hand happened to fall toward the empty space beside her.
Estelle’s eyes immediately lit up.
Without hesitation, she reached over and took his hand.
Her fingers slipped between his, and she gently intertwined their hands.
’Success!’
Estelle felt an almost triumphant happiness inside her.
She didn’t even realize that Luke no longer cared about anything happening around him.
At this point, the Hero of Light was already mentally preparing for his impending funeral.

Well...
Most of them, at least.
Because after watching the situation unfold, everyone had reached roughly the same conclusion.
The great Hero of Light, the terrifying Womanizier...
...was now sitting there like a dead man because his wife had caught him surrounded by three beautiful women.
And judging by Selene’s smile from across the arena, everyone could already imagine the third-degree treatment waiting for him once the battle ended.
Selene turned her attention back toward the arena, where Brynessa was still in her enormous serpent form.
"Sorry, Brynessa, but I have to end this fight quickly. My husband just can’t seem to sit alone without me."
And unfortunately, that was the truth.
Luke was currently sitting between three other women.
Brynessa also noticed him, along with Alia, Estelle, and Isaria surrounding him. The sight immediately stirred something unpleasant deep within her mind, pulling an old memory to the surface.
She remembered the Elf Hero.
The man she had once trusted completely.
The man who had told her she was special, accepted everything she offered him, and made her believe that perhaps someone could genuinely love her.
Only for him to use her and throw her away the moment she asked for that love in return.
"Heroes aren’t trustworthy, and they don’t love us," Brynessa muttered absentmindedly, almost as though she were speaking to herself.
Selene heard her clearly.
She shook her head.
"I know what happened to you, Brynessa, but I know my Luke loves me."
Her tone was calm, and there was no hesitation in her voice.
She shook her head once more, refusing to let Brynessa continue.
Not because she wanted to prove anything to her.
Selene simply didn’t care what anyone else believed about their relationship.
She knew what she felt.
She knew what Luke felt.
And, more importantly, she knew that Luke was hers.
Hers alone.
As for making sure that remained the case, she would deal with that properly after this ridiculous Twilight Era ruin exploration finally ended.
"Foolish..." Brynessa muttered.
She didn’t continue the discussion either.
She already knew that Selene and the other four princesses who had married Luke were bound to him through chains, Created by goddess.

In Brynessa’s eyes, that was simply another method the gods and goddesses had created to ensure that the heroes partner, remained under their heros control, becoming useful pieces on the board that could help those divine beings achieve their own goals.
At least, that was what Iveron, her Demon God, had told her.

Unfortunately for him, the System had already gained plenty of experience dealing with situations like this.
It specialized in creating healthy yandere-like chaos, so how could a mere newborn Titan possibly defeat it?
[Heh~ I am sure, the thing poking down at Isaria A*s, if enter now.

I haven’t completed my mission yet!
All I want!
Just a small HOLE!"
"A small hole!
Which I would make big by myself!!"
"Wait!
I only need one tiny chance!"
"Just a little more!"
"NOOOO!"

Like a childhood friend.

And the System pity him.
Its grand scheme had failed before it could reach its conclusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: The Scarlet Queen vs. the High B-Rank Snake Princess!
paragraphs: "Start."
Peiro finally spoke, clearly growing bored with their conversation.
The battle began.
Whoosh!
The instant his words ended, Selene leaped backward, creating distance between herself and Brynessa.
She needed enough space to bring out her abilities properly.
Brynessa didn’t pursue her.
She simply watched, allowing Selene to display whatever power she intended to use.
Once Selene had revealed everything she possessed, Brynessa would crush her pride, shatter her confidence, and prove that placing one’s trust in a hero was nothing more than a mistake.
She would do it by killing Selene’s hero.
Her husband. Right in front of her.
Selene continued retreating until she had reached roughly one kilometer away. Only then did she stop. Then her expression became serious.

The playful wife who had been teasing Luke moments ago had completely disappeared, replaced by the Scarlet Queen whom very few people in this world had ever had the opportunity to witness fighting seriously.
She raised her hand.
’S-RANK ORIGIN SKILL.’
"Crimson Throne!"
The instant those words escaped her lips, countless blood-like tendrils erupted from her body.
They spread outward before curling behind her, intertwining with one another and gradually taking shape.
The strange mass of dark crimson blood continued gathering and forming a single structure behind Selene.
At once, every spectator’s attention shifted toward the arena.
Even Alia, Isaria, and Estelle stopped paying attention to Luke and turned their gazes toward the battle.
Everyone except Luke.
He was still slumped deep in his chair like a man whose soul had temporarily abandoned his body.
Soon, the strange structure behind Selene was completed.
A crimson throne formed entirely from blood now stood behind her.

Dark crimson blood continuously flowed across its surface, almost as though the throne itself were alive. Its design resembled an ancient royal throne, with a tall backrest, sharp crimson edges, and a faint red glow running throughout its entire structure.
"So it’s finally starting," Zeyr said with anticipation.
Even the Empyrean Academy representatives became more attentive. They rarely had the opportunity to witness the Scarlet Queen in combat.
And now, they were finally about to see what she could truly do.
Selene didn’t sit upon the throne immediately.
Instead, she prepared to reveal something she had never shown publicly before.
At least, not in front of an audience like this.
She slowly spread both arms wide, as though welcoming something that had been waiting beyond the boundaries of the world.
"B-RANK INNATE ABILITY."
The moment those words left her mouth, the surrounding space suddenly cracked.
Fractures appeared above her, below her, and on both sides of her body, spreading across the air like cracks appearing across glass.
It looked as though Selene had forcibly created a gateway connected to another dimension.
And from those fractures, blood began pouring out.
Dark crimson blood.
An immense quantity of it.
The blood surged through the spatial fractures and rushed directly toward Selene, surrounding her before merging into her body.
Everyone’s eyes widened. "She awakened her innate ability!"
The spectators were stunned.
For an beast or speices, an innate ability could be awakened from birth or emerge at some point later in life.
But for the descendants of an Emperor, an innate ability awakening was something entirely different.
It represented the awakening of the hidden inheritance sleeping within their bloodline.
The power of their ancestor could manifest through them, with the final strength depending on their own mastery and compatibility with that inheritance.
Because of that, every Emperor’s child was essentially involved in an invisible race. Everyone wanted to know who would awaken their innate ability first after reaching B-rank.
And now Selene had done exactly that.
At the early B-rank stage.
That alone demonstrated just how extraordinary her talent was.
Even Brynessa was stunned. But the surprise on her face quickly transformed into something else.
Jealousy.
Deep, bitter jealousy.
’Why can she awaken it, but not me?’ For an instant, Brynessa felt as though the entire world itself was conspiring against her.
It wasn’t actually guaranteed that every Emperor’s child would awaken their innate ability at early B-rank.
However, one fact had already been established.
Every Emperor’s child would awaken their innate ability before reaching A-rank. That much had already been proven.
Yet Brynessa had failed to awaken hers early.
Because of that, her peers had mocked her. Among the other Emperor’s children, she had eventually become a laughingstock.
She had already reached High B-rank, standing just below Peak B-rank, and still hadn’t awakened the inheritance sleeping within her blood.
That had also been one of the reasons she had fallen in love with the Elf Hero.
He had supported her, told her that she was special.
He had told her that she didn’t need to compare herself with anyone else. And she had believed him.
After that, she did everything he asked.
She gave him everything she possessed. Her resources and treasures.
Even things that should have remained exclusive to the Beast Empire’s Emperor’s treasury.
She didn’t care. All she wanted was his love.
She had even given him secret information about the Beast Empire, information that could be considered treasonous if exposed.
Yet even after giving him so much, his attitude toward her gradually changed.
He became distant and cold.
And Brynessa began to fear that he would eventually abandon her. That fear was what pushed her into making the proposal.
She believed that if she could break the curse placed upon her bloodline by their ancestral Snake God, everything would change.
She would become stronger and even more useful to him. And perhaps, after becoming stronger, she could finally become someone he could never abandon.
But she had never realized the real reason behind his actions.
He had always been afraid of her. Afraid that one day she would surpass him.
Afraid that the woman who loved him so desperately would one day become stronger than the hero everyone worshipped.
So after taking everything from her, he rejected her pleas and made certain that no one else would truly love her.
He wanted to make sure that she would never break her curse.
So he spread rumors, words and even her private images.
He destroyed the reputation of the woman who had once given him everything. And in the end, he succeeded.
Brynessa committed suicide.
He thought that was the end. But the Elf Hero had forgotten one thing.
The gods were far above mortals.
Their schemes went deeper than anything a mortal could understand.
And so, Brynessa was resurrected.
Iveron found her.
He revealed the truth about the Elf Hero and explained why the hero had done everything to her.
After that, Brynessa became his pawn.
Even so, her potential remained nearly equal to that of the other Emperor’s children.
There was only one thing Iveron had been waiting for.
Her awakening.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Selene Finally Shows Why Emperor Bloodlines Are Terrifying!
paragraphs: Because the day Brynessa awakened her innate ability, he knew that she could become an insane prodigy, perhaps something this world had never seen before.
And such a prodigy could become one of the keys he needed to return to Valtharion.
Sadly, Brynessa knew nothing of that plan. She knew nothing about what Iveron truly wanted.
All she knew was revenge.
Yet now, standing before Selene and watching another prodigy awaken her Emperor bloodline’s hidden inheritance at early B-rank, Brynessa felt all those old wounds opening again.
The humiliation, rejection... and the loneliness.
The feeling that everyone else was moving forward while she remained behind. All of it came rushing back at once.
Her eyes slowly narrowed as the crimson blood continued merging into Selene’s body.
And for the first time since entering the arena, the hatred in Brynessa’s eyes was no longer directed solely at heroes.
It was directed at the unfairness of the world itself.

At that moment, Selene’s transformation finally came to an end, and another set of words escaped her lips, but unlike her usual playful tone, her voice carried a regal authority that made it sound as though the figure standing before everyone was no longer a mere mortal, but a sovereign who had descended upon the battlefield.
"Blood Sovereign."
"WHAT?!"

The instant those words reached everyone’s ears, even Zeyr lost his balance and nearly fell from his seat, while the same stunned reaction spread through the rest of the spectators, because everyone who understood the implications of those two words, especially the members of the Empyrean Academy, knew exactly what Selene’s declaration meant.
Even Brynessa felt a deep sense of fear upon hearing that title.
After Emperor came Sovereign, and only beings who had reached that level were capable of carrying the title of Sovereign.
"A Demi-God!"

The words almost escaped everyone’s mouths at the same time, and the shock surrounding the arena became so intense that even Luke, who had been slumped in his chair like a man whose soul had already abandoned his body, finally lifted his head.
’Demi-God?’
Confusion appeared in his eyes, but before he could even process what that meant, another explanation reached his ears.
"She awakened an innate ability inherited from an ancestor who was a Demi-God."
Alia covered her mouth with both hands as she stared at Selene in disbelief, because even for someone as knowledgeable as her, this development was absurd.

Normally, when an Emperor’s child awakened their innate ability, the inheritance that manifested would belong to an Emperor-level ancestor, meaning an inheritance equivalent to a Saint-level power, but whenever someone managed to awaken an innate ability inherited from a Sovereign, the result had always been completely different.
"They ended up becoming Demi-Gods."
The moment those words were spoken, even Luke became completely flabbergasted.

This meant that Selene now had a significantly higher possibility of eventually becoming a Demi-God compared with the other children of Emperors, because she had awakened an inheritance that had already reached the Sovereign level.
As that thought entered Luke’s mind, the familiar System screen once again appeared before him.
[Tch! She isn’t a Demi-God right now, you know, or else you’d already have a sugar mommy, and after that you could probably sleep with any woman in Valtharion because no one would dare stop you.]
’Yeah, because my Demi-God wife would probably kill me herself before anyone else even got the chance.’

Luke gave the System screen a completely speechless look, wondering where the hell it kept coming up with these terrible ideas, considering that every single one of them seemed specifically designed to shorten his lifespan.
For a moment, the System remained silent, but then it immediately changed the subject.
[Luke, look! Your wife’s Sovereign form is finally ready!]
The System instantly shifted his attention back toward the arena before disappearing from view.
’Tch.’
Luke clicked his tongue lightly, but his eyes nevertheless returned to Selene, whose Blood Sovereign form had now fully manifested.

Her new body stood one hundred feet tall and resembled a gigantic version of Selene herself, except that her entire form had been created from condensed blood and the immense power contained within her Origin.

Every part of her body carried the deep crimson color of blood, yet unlike ordinary blood, the substance forming her Sovereign body possessed an extraordinary density, giving the entire figure a strange sense of solidity despite its origin.
Looking at that gigantic version of his wife, which was almost identical to her normal appearance except for its scale and supernatural nature, an absurd thought somehow surfaced inside Luke’s mind.
’Some of my Titan forms are also around one hundred feet tall, so does that mean we could actually—’
Before he could finish the thought, the System had already appeared with another comment.
[For your dragon wife, you’d have to fck her in her dragon form, because dragons don’t mate in their humanoid forms, and some of them can be over a hundred meters long.]
Luke fell completely silent.
So the system was suggesting he got a titan origin ability, so he was able to f*ck all of his wives successfully.
He honestly didn’t know what kind of response such an idea deserved, so he simply decided that remaining silent was the safest possible choice.
And chose not to discuss any further on the topic of *f*ck!!!*
Down in the arena, Selene’s transformation into the Blood Sovereign had changed more than just her body.

The crimson throne behind her, which had previously been large enough for her ordinary body to sit upon, suddenly began expanding along with her transformation, its structure stretching outward until it had become large enough to accommodate her one-hundred-foot Blood Sovereign form.
"Hmm."

Selene gave a quiet hum as she settled onto the throne, resting one arm casually against its armrest before turning her gaze toward the floating Brynessa, whose thousand-foot-long serpent body still occupied a significant portion of the arena.
"I am ready."
The moment those words escaped Selene’s mouth, however, something about her Blood Sovereign body changed.
The streams of blood that had previously flowed visibly across her form suddenly stopped moving.

Her entire body paused for an instant before the condensed blood completely solidified, leaving her appearance almost identical to that of a living being made from flesh rather than a figure formed from blood.
Brynessa’s eyes narrowed as she carefully observed the transformation.
’Her control over blood has increased.’
She immediately understood what had happened, realizing that Selene’s Origin Skill and newly awakened innate ability were naturally forming a powerful synergy.
That was bad news.
