Normally, when an Emperor’s child awakened their innate ability, the inheritance that manifested would belong to an Emperor-level ancestor, meaning an inheritance equivalent to a Saint-level power, but whenever someone managed to awaken an innate ability inherited from a Sovereign, the result had always been completely different.
"They ended up becoming Demi-Gods."
The moment those words were spoken, even Luke became completely flabbergasted.

This meant that Selene now had a significantly higher possibility of eventually becoming a Demi-God compared with the other children of Emperors, because she had awakened an inheritance that had already reached the Sovereign level.
As that thought entered Luke’s mind, the familiar System screen once again appeared before him.
[Tch!
She isn’t a Demi-God right now, you know, or else you’d already have a sugar mommy, and after that you could probably sleep with any woman in Valtharion because no one would dare stop you.]
’Yeah, because my Demi-God wife would probably kill me herself before anyone else even got the chance.’

Luke gave the System screen a completely speechless look, wondering where the hell it kept coming up with these terrible ideas, considering that every single one of them seemed specifically designed to shorten his lifespan.
For a moment, the System remained silent, but then it immediately changed the subject.
[Luke, look!
Your wife’s Sovereign form is finally ready!]
The System instantly shifted his attention back toward the arena before disappearing from view.
’Tch.’
Luke clicked his tongue lightly, but his eyes nevertheless returned to Selene, whose Blood Sovereign form had now fully manifested.

Her new body stood one hundred feet tall and resembled a gigantic version of Selene herself, except that her entire form had been created from condensed blood and the immense power contained within her Origin.

Every part of her body carried the deep crimson color of blood, yet unlike ordinary blood, the substance forming her Sovereign body possessed an extraordinary density, giving the entire figure a strange sense of solidity despite its origin.
Looking at that gigantic version of his wife, which was almost identical to her normal appearance except for its scale and supernatural nature, an absurd thought somehow surfaced inside Luke’s mind.
’Some of my Titan forms are also around one hundred feet tall, so does that mean we could actually—’
Before he could finish the thought, the System had already appeared with another comment.
[For your dragon wife, you’d have to fck her in her dragon form, because dragons don’t mate in their humanoid forms, and some of them can be over a hundred meters long.]
Luke fell completely silent.
So the system was suggesting he got a titan origin ability, so he was able to f*ck all of his wives successfully.
He honestly didn’t know what kind of response such an idea deserved, so he simply decided that remaining silent was the safest possible choice.
And chose not to discuss any further on the topic of *f*ck!!!*
Down in the arena, Selene’s transformation into the Blood Sovereign had changed more than just her body.

The crimson throne behind her, which had previously been large enough for her ordinary body to sit upon, suddenly began expanding along with her transformation, its structure stretching outward until it had become large enough to accommodate her one-hundred-foot Blood Sovereign form.
"Hmm."

Selene gave a quiet hum as she settled onto the throne, resting one arm casually against its armrest before turning her gaze toward the floating Brynessa, whose thousand-foot-long serpent body still occupied a significant portion of the arena.
"I am ready."
The moment those words escaped Selene’s mouth, however, something about her Blood Sovereign body changed.
The streams of blood that had previously flowed visibly across her form suddenly stopped moving.

Her entire body paused for an instant before the condensed blood completely solidified, leaving her appearance almost identical to that of a living being made from flesh rather than a figure formed from blood.
Brynessa’s eyes narrowed as she carefully observed the transformation.
’Her control over blood has increased.’
She immediately understood what had happened, realizing that Selene’s Origin Skill and newly awakened innate ability were naturally forming a powerful synergy.
That was bad news.

chapters.title: Chapter 321: The Venomous Serpent's Fatal Prophecy Begins!
paragraphs: Still, Brynessa didn't believe she would lose.
She was a High B-rank, while Selene was still only at the Early B-rank, and despite the terrifying inheritance Selene had just awakened, the difference between their cultivation realms remained real.
Brynessa therefore called upon her own Origin Skill.
'S-RANK ORIGIN SKILL.'
The declaration existed only within her thoughts, and after activating the skill, she spoke a low whisper that was so faint that only Peiro was capable of hearing it.
"Fate of the Venomous Serpent."
Yet nothing appeared to happen.

There was no visible surge of power, no dramatic transformation of the surrounding space, and no obvious supernatural phenomenon that would indicate that an S-Rank Origin Skill had just been activated.
Peiro, however, raised his eyebrow slightly.
'A magic that belongs only to demons has appeared within the Beast Race.'
'Interesting.'
He didn't say anything aloud, but the strange nature of Brynessa's power further convinced him that her existence, and perhaps even her birth itself, was not as simple as it appeared.
Meanwhile, everyone else remained confused because Brynessa had clearly activated her Origin Skill, yet nothing seemed to have changed.
Before anyone could properly react or even begin wondering what she had done, Brynessa spoke another phrase.
"S̷e̷r̷p̷e̷n̷t̷'̷s̷ ̷O̷m̷e̷n̷"
Everyone heard something, but to their ears, the words sounded like incomprehensible gibberish, as though the sounds themselves refused to conform to the language they knew.
Selene's expression, however, became serious.

She had read about something similar in her family's library before, and she remembered that certain demons were capable of using words that technically belonged to the Valtharion language, yet were still fundamentally different from ordinary speech.
Later, scholars had discovered why.

Conceptual magic could not be spoken through normal words, because every individual word and every single letter within that ancient form of language carried its own power, something ordinary Valtharion words simply could not contain.

It was similar to trying to write a name upon sand with nothing more than a stick, because although the name could be written, even the slightest movement of wind would be enough to erase it and scatter the grains until the original meaning disappeared.

To properly express conceptual magic, the user needed a higher level of language, or perhaps an entirely different form of letters and words capable of remaining intact until the concept itself had completed its function.

Selene also remembered that the books had mentioned several famous examples of conceptual magic, including curses, fate, destiny, luck, and other powers that could not be understood through ordinary magical principles.
That was exactly why her expression had become so serious.
Conceptual magic could not be judged by normal standards.
And in the very next moment, that truth became clear.
A small spectral serpent appeared behind Selene's crimson throne.

It was only about one foot in size, yet despite its tiny body, its appearance immediately created an uncomfortable sensation in the surrounding atmosphere as it hovered near the upper portion of the throne, positioned close to Selene's head.
Selene's eyes narrowed. While a bad premonition rose within her heart.
'Curse magic?'
If Brynessa could hear that thought, she would have laughed.
Selene was right.
It was curse magic.
Yet Brynessa's Origin Skill was called Fate.
The irony of that contradiction was something Brynessa herself had never managed to understand throughout her life.
Why was she called a user of fate when the actual ability produced by her Origin Skill behaved like a curse?
She had once asked Iveron about it.
'Was fate a curse?'
But Iveron had never answered her directly.
Instead, he had simply told her that fate belonged to things that had been forgotten, things that could no longer be touched.
At the time, Brynessa had misunderstood his words.

She had believed perhaps Iveron meant that fate itself had disappeared from the world and that nobody could truly wield the power of fate anymore, which would explain why the name of her Origin Skill had remained Fate while the actual ability it produced had become something closer to a curse.
Yet even now, the answer remained unknown.
And as the small spectral serpent floated silently behind Selene's throne, that contradiction once again revealed just how strange Brynessa's power truly was.
"What's this?"

The others were equally confused as they watched a small spectral serpent appear beside Selene, yet none of them could identify what they were actually looking at, because only the members of the Royal Family—and even among them, primarily those belonging to the Emperor's bloodline—had access to knowledge regarding this kind of magic.

The last Demon War had happened far too long ago, and most of the people living in the current time had never witnessed the rare conceptual-type magic that had once terrified entire generations. As time passed, much of that knowledge had been buried inside ancient records, while the true horror of such abilities had gradually faded from the world's collective memory.
But now, this was something many of them were about to remember today.
Brynessa didn't stop after creating the first curse.
Instead, she continued building her spell, quietly casting several more curses toward Selene.
"P̷r̷o̷p̷h̷e̷t̷i̷c̷ ̷B̷i̷n̷d̷"
The instant the strange words were spoken, invisible threads of curse power emerged from Brynessa's Origin and silently connected themselves to Selene's Blood Sovereign body.
No one in the arena could perceive those threads.
The only person capable of seeing them clearly was Peiro.

Selene, meanwhile, remained calmly seated upon her Crimson Throne as she tried to understand what Brynessa was doing. The information she had encountered in her family's library regarding conceptual magic had been extremely limited, and the deeper records containing more detailed information were kept inside sections that she had never been permitted to access.
Still, there were two things she distinctly remembered, and both were important.
The first was that if a curse user was killed, the curse would eventually disappear with them.
The second was far more important.

One should never act rashly after being cursed, because curses possessed activation conditions, and if the victim didn't understand what those conditions were, a reckless reaction could cause the curse to progress further or trap the victim within its effects.
Selene had already lost the first advantage.
She couldn't simply kill Brynessa before understanding what kind of curse had been placed upon her, which was precisely why she remained where she was instead of launching an immediate attack.
She needed to understand the curse, even if she could only figure out part of its effect.
After all, a curse didn't necessarily reveal or activate its full potential the instant it was cast.
Brynessa continued her preparations and cast a third curse.
"S̷e̷v̷e̷n̷f̷o̷l̷d̷ ̷O̷m̷e̷n̷"
This time, seven small purple symbols appeared around Selene's Crimson Throne, each one representing a different omen.
𖤐
𖥂
𖦹
𖧧
𖨆
𖫔
The strange symbols hovered silently around the throne, rotating slowly around her.

Selene narrowed her eyes as she examined them, but even she had never seen those symbols before, while the spectators were equally confused because none of them could understand what the seven strange marks represented.
Brynessa, however, continued without hesitation.
She had already finished preparing everything she needed. Now it was time to use her ultimate ability.
'S-RANK ORIGIN SKILL: Fate of the Venomous Serpent.'
'ULTIMATE SKILL!'
The declaration existed within Brynessa's mind, and in front of her gigantic serpent head, a small purple magical symbol slowly began forming in the air.
It didn't simply appear. The symbol was being written.

One strange mark after another emerged as though an invisible hand were tracing each letter through space itself, and before anyone could understand what Brynessa was actually writing, another voice escaped her lips.
"F̷a̷t̷a̷l̷ ̷P̷r̷o̷p̷h̷e̷c̷y̷"

chapters.title: Chapter 322: Luke Finally Realizes How Powerful His Wife Is! [GOLDEN TICKET BONUS]
paragraphs: The moment the final word was completed, the purple symbol suddenly ignited.
Purple flames consumed it within an instant before the entire magical inscription vanished.
Yet the disappearance lasted for less than a breath.
The next moment, a gigantic purple magic circle suddenly manifested beneath Selene and her Crimson Throne, its intricate patterns spreading across the ground in an instant.
"This!"
The spectators were left baffled.

The magic circle stretched for one hundred meters, and the fact that Brynessa had created something of that scale instantly without any prior preparation was enough to shock even the experienced members of the audience.
Normally, an Arcane Mage at B-rank couldn't simply construct a gigantic magic circle of this size and complexity in an instant.

That was precisely why B-rank mages often prepared their larger spells beforehand and stored them within their Arcane Hearts, allowing them to release the prepared formations when necessary rather than constructing them from nothing during battle.
Brynessa, however, had created hers effortlessly.
Even Luke, despite everything he had already witnessed during this battle, sensed that something about the situation wasn't right.
'Why isn't Selene attacking?'
The same question naturally emerged within the minds of many spectators.
Brynessa had spent all this time preparing her spells, yet Selene had done almost nothing to interfere with her.
Still, Selene's turn had finally arrived.
Selene watched Brynessa carefully and gradually realized that the serpent had become quiet, no longer continuing her preparations.
It was as though everything she needed to place into position had finally been completed. And now she was simply waiting.
'Since I am already trapped inside her setup, I'll just overpower her.'
Selene settled on the decision without hesitation.

She couldn't undo what had already been done, so rather than wasting time attempting to unravel an unknown curse, she would simply overwhelm Brynessa with superior power before those curses could become a true threat.
Her crimson eyes became sharper as she called upon the full power of her Origin Skill.
'S-RANK ORIGIN SKILL!
'Crimson Throne, ULTIMATE ABILITY!'
Then she spoke the final words.
"WORLD OF CRIMSON"
Unlike the strange conceptual words Brynessa had used, Selene's voice wasn't as heavy or incomprehensible, yet the words she spoke were still different from the ordinary language of Valtharion.
And the moment Brynessa heard them, the expression on her gigantic serpent face changed completely.
'A World Skill!'
Her pupils narrowed.
'Domain!'

Brynessa felt a strange bitterness spread through her heart as she looked at Selene, because the appearance of a domain at this stage was something that shouldn't have been possible for an ordinary Early B-rank.
Domains belonged to higher-tier existences, and even an A-rank being couldn't necessarily create one unless they possessed sufficient talent and understanding of their power.
Yet Selene had done it.
An Early B-rank had formed a domain. And the reason was simple.
Valtharion itself had granted her an Origin Skill capable of allowing such a thing to happen.
'Valtharion really is unfair.'

Brynessa could only sigh internally when she thought about her own situation, because while she had struggled to awaken her true Origin inheritance, Selene continued receiving one extraordinary advantage after another.
But Selene's World of Crimson didn't stop merely because Brynessa felt bitter about her fate.
The instant her words were completed, the Crimson Throne released its full authority.
*Blood Authority.*

Crimson energy immediately spread outward from the throne, flowing across the battlefield like veins spreading beneath the surface of the earth, while the sky above slowly transformed into a deep crimson color.
At the same time, every trace of blood left behind by the previous battles throughout the arena began responding to Selene.

Blood that had previously belonged to the wounded, blood that had been scattered across the ground, and blood that had soaked into the earth were all connected to her authority, forming a network that allowed Selene to manipulate the entire battlefield as though every drop were an extension of her own body.
The Blood Throne Dominion expanded toward its maximum range.
For Selene's current strength, that range reached a diameter of ten kilometers.

Within that territory, her perception expanded through the blood contained inside every living creature, allowing her to sense their presence while simultaneously granting her the ability to manipulate the blood spread throughout the entire domain.
The transformation continued until the full ten-kilometer area had effectively become a crimson world of its own.
Brynessa's enormous serpent body floated within the blood-red sky as the entire battlefield fell under Selene's control.
Then, beneath her, the earth began to bleed.
The ground had been wounded by the battles that had taken place across the arena, and now those wounds became sources of fresh blood as crimson streams began emerging from beneath the soil.
One stream became another, and another joined it, until countless currents of blood rose upward and flowed through the air, converging around Selene's Crimson Throne.
"A domain!"
Zeyr and the other Empyrean representatives fell silent as they stared at the transformation, because they understood exactly what it represented, just as Brynessa did.
"No one can defeat her in the B-rank anymore, even if they're at Peak B-rank, unless they possess something capable of countering her domain or have a domain of their own."
The words came naturally from one of the spectators who had already learned about the terrifying superiority domains could provide.
The streams of blood continuously rising from the ground served as undeniable proof of what had happened.
Inside her domain, Selene's authority was supreme.

Even if an opponent possessed an extremely powerful blood-manipulation ability of their own, Selene could potentially force control over the blood within that opponent's body, turning their own blood into another weapon under her command.
That was the true horror of a domain.
"And unless another element can overpower her Blood Element while inside that domain, they won't even be able to damage her body effectively."
The explanation continued as everyone watched the crimson environment surrounding Selene.
"Even if someone manages to do that, they still won't necessarily be able to fight her properly, because her innate ability also seems to be forming perfect synergy with her Origin Skill."
Hearing that, the surrounding spectators nodded one after another as they finally understood how terrifying Selene's current state had become.
Even Luke looked surprised.
'My wife is this strong, and nobody even told me.'

'Now I'm dead.'
At the same time, his already-defeated little brother twitched faintly, almost as if it were trying to remind him of something.
"That's your karma for not letting me complete my mission."
"The mission to enter a hole! ᕦ(ò_óˇ)ᕤ"
Luke, fortunately, couldn't hear any of that.
And even if he somehow could, he definitely wouldn't want to.
Meanwhile, on the opposite side of the arena, both Mella and Marrec's expressions had changed as they looked toward Brynessa and the crimson domain surrounding her opponent.
"Can she handle this?"
"Miss Brynessa is very strong, and she will be able to!"
Mella immediately rebuked Marrec, clearly displeased by the implication that Brynessa might be unable to handle Selene's power.
Marrec immediately stopped speaking.
He simply kept his eyes fixed on the battlefield, waiting to discover what the outcome of the confrontation between the two powerful women would ultimately be.
Selene looked toward the still-floating thousand-foot-long serpent and narrowed her crimson eyes.
"I have to bring her down."
As she muttered those words, she slowly raised one hand, and Brynessa immediately noticed the movement, her serpentine eyes narrowing as she prepared herself for whatever Selene intended to do next.
"CRIMSON THRONE'S JUDGMENT"

The moment Selene activated another authority of her Crimson Throne, the entire throne began glowing with a deeper crimson radiance, and directly above Brynessa's gigantic serpent body, an equally gigantic crimson sigil suddenly manifested in the air.
Brynessa barely had enough time to look upward and understand what had appeared above her before the Crimson Throne pulsed again, this time releasing a far stronger wave of authority.
The crimson sigil immediately descended with tremendous force.
"This!"
Brynessa's eyes widened as she suddenly felt something deeply wrong happening within her own body, because the blood flowing through her veins no longer seemed to obey her completely.

Her blood began behaving strangely, as though an unseen force were attempting to pull it out of her control, and that interference spread through her entire body, causing unusual spasms to run through her muscles.

The effect was subtle at first, but with every passing second, it became harder for her to maintain complete control over her body, and even keeping herself suspended in the air began requiring more concentration than before.
Brynessa understood that she needed to act.
She immediately invoked another one of her curses.
"F̷a̷l̷s̷e̷ ̷P̷r̷o̷p̷h̷e̷c̷y̷"
Another incomprehensible phrase escaped her lips, yet unlike the strange words that had previously seemed to produce no visible effect, the result this time was immediate.
Selene suddenly discovered that the gigantic crimson sigil above Brynessa had disappeared.
At almost the same time, she looked down and realized that one of the solid blood hands belonging to her Blood Sovereign form had also vanished.
Selene's expression changed.
'What?'
She couldn't understand what had just happened.
She had never seen Brynessa launch an attack, yet her Crimson Throne's Judgment had somehow disappeared, and one of the part manifested by her own Blood Sovereign form was gone as well.

The more Selene tried to recall exactly what had happened, the more confused she became, because she couldn't remember what Brynessa had actually done during that final instant when the serpent had been trapped beneath the crimson sigil.
While Selene was struggling to understand it, her Blood Sovereign body began glowing intensely from within.
Something was happening inside her.

Whatever Brynessa had done was being actively resisted by Selene's Blood Sovereign form, as though the power inherited from her Demi-God ancestor was attempting to remove the foreign influence that had entered her body.
That resistance, however, came at a price.

Because Selene's concentration had shifted toward dealing with the foreign power, her control over the Crimson Throne weakened, causing its crimson glow to become noticeably dimmer, and as the throne's authority fell, the crimson sigil above Brynessa also lost much of its previous suppressive power.
From the outside, the change left everyone confused.
"What's happening? Why did Selene suddenly stop exerting pressure on Brynessa?"
The question spread among the spectators, but there were only a few beings who truly understood what was happening.
Peiro knew.
The System knew.
Brynessa knew.
None of them had any intention of explaining it to the others.
Before anyone could make sense of the strange situation, a sound suddenly came from Selene's body.
Krrk!
Crack!
The sound resembled glass breaking under pressure, and the instant it echoed through the arena, Brynessa released a painful, serpentine cry.
"HISSSS—AAARGH!"
Everyone became confused again.

The attention of the spectators immediately returned to the arena, where Selene's Blood Sovereign form could be seen taking a deep breath, almost like someone who had just awakened from an incredibly realistic nightmare.
'Huff... huff... I am out.'

Selene inhaled deeply as she tried to calm herself, because for what felt like an agonizingly long period, she had been trapped inside an illusion so realistic that she had experienced the sensation of her body being cut apart piece by piece.
She had never seen what was cutting her. And never understood how the attack was happening.
She had only experienced the pain. Yet now she was free.
Selene slowly lifted her head, and her eyes immediately fell upon the gigantic crimson sigil from earlier, which was now glowing once again above the battlefield.

Brynessa's enormous serpent body had shifted slightly from its previous position, almost as though she had attempted to escape the area beneath the sigil, yet she had once again been forced underneath it, and now her body was trembling as painful cries escaped her throat.
Brynessa was clearly suffering from something else.
'A curse-break backlash.'
Selene's expression became heavy as she finally understood what had happened, and for the first time, she truly began to grasp the terror of curse magic.
She had been affected without even realizing it.

That was what made conceptual curses so troublesome to deal with, because their effects didn't always announce themselves through visible power or straightforward attacks, and by the time the victim understood what was happening, the curse might already have fulfilled part of its purpose.
Selene sighed internally.

Within her domain, she could overpower ordinary elemental abilities through the authority of her Blood Element, but conceptual powers were different because they were based on principles she couldn't simply dominate through greater physical force, especially when she wasn't yet at a level where she could freely perceive and interfere with such concepts.
Yet before she could think about it any further, a small hiss came from behind her.
"Tsss..."
Selene immediately became alert and turned her head. But what she saw caused her pupils to widen.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: Selene Just Summoned an Army of B-Rank Warriors! [POWER STONE BONUS]
paragraphs: "How did its size increase?"
The small spectral serpent that had previously been floating harmlessly behind her throne was still there, but its body had changed.
It had originally been only one foot long.
Now it was ten feet long.
Despite that increase, the spectral serpent still floated almost helplessly behind the throne, giving no obvious indication that it had done anything at all.
Selene stared at it for a moment before extending her hand toward the surrounding blood.
A small blood spear quickly formed within the crimson atmosphere and shot directly toward the spectral creature.
Whoosh!
Bang!
The spear passed straight through the serpent as though it didn’t physically exist before striking the ground below and creating a one-meter-deep crater.
Selene’s eyes widened further.
Yet before she could understand what had happened, the spectral serpent suddenly grew again.
Its body stretched until it became eleven feet long.

Even then, it continued floating behind her throne in the same seemingly harmless manner, resembling either an oddly helpless pet or a predator patiently waiting for the right moment to attack, after it grow.
Selene noticed the increase, but she failed to notice something far more important.
The purple magic circle beneath her had been glowing throughout the entire process.
When she had launched the blood spear, a portion of her power had been transferred through the circle and into the spectral serpent.
That energy had caused the serpent to grow.
She also failed to notice the invisible thread connecting her to Brynessa, which had thickened slightly during the same process.
Meanwhile, Brynessa finally managed to break free from the backlash caused by her curse being resisted.
"Huff!"
Her breathing remained rough, and her mind was still somewhat disoriented, while the Origin within her body remained disturbed by the backlash, but she was at least able to think clearly again.
Her attention immediately returned to the curse she had used against Selene.
"False Prophecy"
Type: Origin Ability
Classification: Illusory Curse Magic
Brynessa creates a false omen inside a cursed target’s mind.
The target begins receiving brief visions of possible attacks, injuries, or movements.
These visions are not actual future predictions; they are curse-generated distortions created to interfere with decision-making.
Uses:
• Confuses powerful enemies.
• Causes hesitation.
• Makes evasive movement unreliable.
• Creates openings for Brynessa’s actual attacks.
Brynessa understood exactly why the curse had failed.
"That damn Demi-God innate form..." she cursed quietly beneath her breath.

Selene couldn’t actually wield genuine Demi-God-level power or cast true Demi-God-level spells, but through her innate ability, she was still able to access certain properties of that inheritance, although only at an extremely weak level compared with a real Demi-God.
Apparently, one of those properties was resistance to various forms of magic.
And that was only natural.

Once beings reached the Demi-God level, they possessed enough time, knowledge, and power to perfect their abilities, and many of them would naturally develop forms or abilities capable of defending against different types of supernatural attacks, including conceptual forms of magic.
Therefore, even though Selene’s Blood Sovereign form was nowhere near the actual power of a true Demi-God, it still retained some of those defensive properties.
That was why Brynessa’s direct curse attack had failed to affect her properly.
"Well, I only have one direct curse," Brynessa reminded herself as she considered her remaining abilities.
Her Fatal Prophecy, Serpent’s Omen, and Prophetic Bind were all growth-type curse powers, while Sevenfold Omen was different because it was both direct and indirect.
She wasn’t attacking her opponent directly with Sevenfold Omen. The symbols themselves would act according to their own effects.
And now, it was finally time for them to act.
Brynessa steadied herself as much as possible, although she was still unable to control her descent because the crimson sigil continued suppressing her body.
Her enormous serpent form was already dropping.
She had no way to stop it.
The next instant—
BOOOOOOM!
Her gigantic serpent body crashed into the ground with tremendous force, sending a thick cloud of dust outward while the impact reverberated across the battlefield.
"HISS!"
Brynessa hissed through the pain, but instead of attempting to take flight again, she lowered her long body against the ground and began crawling toward Selene like an actual serpent.
Her decision was clear. She was going to fight physically.

Seeing this, Selene immediately brought her attention back to Brynessa and chose to ignore the strange spectral serpent behind her for the moment, even though she had already noticed that its size seemed to increase whenever she used her power.
She placed both gigantic blood hands firmly against the armrests of the Crimson Throne, her fingers tightening around the crimson material as her Blood Sovereign body leaned forward.
She was ready to answer Brynessa’s advance with another authority.
"BLOOD LEGION"

The moment Selene activated Blood Legion, the surrounding blood that had been continuously rising from the wounded ground began to churn with renewed intensity, and by this point, the entire ten-kilometer area had already been filled with a crimson blood sphere whose lower portion contained nearly a meter of accumulated blood, allowing Brynessa’s thousand-foot-long serpent body to move through it like a snake swimming across a gigantic blood pool.

For a brief moment, nothing seemed to change, but the surface of the blood suddenly began to stir as though something buried beneath it had awakened, and with a sharp whoosh, humanoid figures began emerging one after another from the crimson pool.

Each figure stood ten feet tall, and every one of them possessed a different weapon while wearing armor formed entirely from condensed, solidified blood, giving them the appearance of an army of crimson warriors that had risen directly from Selene’s domain.
More importantly, every single Blood Warrior radiated an Early B-rank aura.
"THIS IS CRAZY!"

The Sunborn warriors could barely believe what they were seeing, because the sight of an Early B-rank being summoning an army in which every individual possessed the same rank was something that completely surpassed their expectations.
Yet this was the reality of true prodigies.

chapters.title: Chapter 325: An Endless Blood Army vs. a Deadly Prophetic Curse! [POWER STONE BONUS]
paragraphs: This was what someone with extraordinary talent could achieve once they had reached a certain level, and this was precisely why Selene had earned another title that had long been associated with her name.

"Scarlet Queen," Marius murmured, and unlike the others, there was almost reverence in his eyes when he spoke those words, because if someone was going to be called a queen, then naturally, she needed a legion worthy of standing beneath her.
Seeing the Scarlet Queen once again, Marius had already forgotten the embarrassing incident from earlier, and his eyes had regained that familiar, almost frantic fascination.

He knew that Selene was a Perfect Vampire, someone born with the potential to rule over the Vampires, and now the awakening of her Demi-God-level innate ability served as further proof of that belief.
From the side, Luke noticed Marius staring at Selene with a foolish smile and couldn’t help feeling confused.
’What’s wrong with him?’
He glanced at Marius for another moment before deciding to ignore him, because even Luke’s attention had been captured by the spectacle unfolding below.
’Even I would have trouble fighting this many opponents at the same level, even if I used some of my larger attacks.’

Luke understood that only his Atlas Titan body could withstand the strain of repeatedly unleashing those high-level techniques, while his other Titan forms would struggle to cross the Mid-B-rank attack threshold if he tried to force out that same kind of destructive power continuously.

Selene remained completely focused on her Blood Legion, paying no attention to the spectral serpent hovering behind her throne, whose size continued increasing with every passing moment, growing by another foot each time it absorbed the energy being fed into it.
Brynessa, meanwhile, had no intention of standing still and allowing the Blood Warriors to surround her.

She moved her thousand-foot-long serpent body through the blood pool and began thrashing from side to side with tremendous force, using her long body and tail to crush the Blood Warriors whenever they came within reach.
BOOM!
BANG!
BAM!

The battlefield immediately became filled with repeated explosions and collisions as her body displaced the surrounding blood, sending waves of crimson liquid surging through the domain while sections of the ground beneath the blood pool were also blasted apart by the force of her movements.
Yet the Blood Warriors continued coming.

They showed no fear and possessed no instinct for self-preservation, rushing toward Brynessa like undead soldiers whose only purpose was to obey Selene’s command, and whenever they reached her enormous body, they drove their blood-forged spears directly into her thick scales.
SHNK!
SHK!
Several spears plunged deep into Brynessa’s body.
"Hiss!"

Pain crossed Brynessa’s expression as she realized that these Blood Warriors were not merely Early B-rank beings in name, because Selene had reinforced their weapons with the authority of her domain, allowing their blood-forged armaments to gain an advantage over Brynessa’s physical characteristics that their raw cultivation alone shouldn’t have provided.
Her naturally powerful body, which should have been capable of resisting attacks from beings of the same rank, was unable to completely stop those spears from piercing through her scales.
"Damn this domain!"

Brynessa immediately understood where the problem came from, because inside Selene’s Blood World, the Blood Warriors were not fighting as ordinary summoned creatures anymore; they were extensions of the domain itself, and the surrounding blood allowed Selene to continuously reinforce and replace them.

With that realization, Brynessa suddenly twisted her entire body and unleashed a violent thrashing motion, driving her enormous form against the blood-covered ground with such force that more than a hundred meters of the battlefield were destroyed beneath her body while dozens upon dozens of Blood Warriors were crushed in the same movement.
BOOOOM!

The impact sent blood surging into the air, and Brynessa emerged from the disturbed pool with her body covered in blood, some of it belonging to the battlefield while the rest came from her own wounds.
She looked around.
"Damn it."

Her expression became increasingly grim as she saw what had happened, because although she had destroyed a large number of Blood Warriors, the blood pool around her immediately began moving again, and new Blood Warriors started rising from it to replace the ones she had just killed.
Selene simply kept replenishing her army.

At this rate, Brynessa would eventually lose through exhaustion alone, because every movement she made consumed stamina and Origin energy, while Selene could continue drawing upon the blood within her domain to restore her legion.
And above her, the crimson sigil created by Crimson Throne’s Judgment was still present, constantly pressing down on her body and making her movements even more difficult.
Brynessa’s serpentine eyes turned toward Selene.

The Blood Sovereign still sat calmly upon her Crimson Throne, with her posture carrying the composure of a true queen who had no reason to rise from her seat while an entire army fought on her behalf.
’Bastard.’
Brynessa cursed internally before deciding to activate her Sevenfold Omen.
"Sevenfold Omen"
Type: Origin Ability
Classification: Prophetic Curse Magic
Brynessa creates seven small purple symbols around a cursed enemy.
Each symbol represents a possible consequence of the curse and activates according to the target’s actions.
One omen can suppress movement.
Another can interfere with energy circulation.
Another can weaken regeneration.
Another can distort perception.
Another can increase the curse’s accumulation rate.
Another can temporarily restrict an ability.
The final omen remains sealed until Brynessa chooses to activate it.
The next moment, the first six symbols began glowing brightly around Selene.
Omen I 𖤐
Omen II 𖥂
Omen III 𖦹
Omen IV 𖧧
Omen V 𖨆
Omen VI 𖩧

Before Selene could understand what Brynessa was attempting to accomplish, she suddenly felt her vision become blurred, and almost immediately afterward, the movements of her Blood Sovereign body began feeling sluggish as though invisible weight had been placed upon every part of her form.
Her internal energy circulation also slowed, and several other subtle changes began occurring throughout her body.
But one of the most noticeable changes was happening behind her.
The spectral serpent had already grown far larger than before, and its body was now nearly one hundred feet long.
Selene remained confused by the strange creature, but before she could focus on it, she felt another disturbance.
Her connection with the Blood Legion suddenly began weakening.
It felt as though something was trying to sever the link between herself and the army she had created.
For a brief moment, it actually succeeded.

All around Brynessa, the Blood Warriors suddenly became directionless, their crimson heads turning and moving without any clear focus as the connection controlling them weakened, and several of them even began attacking one another instead of continuing their assault on Brynessa.
"Hiss!"
Brynessa released a breath of relief as she saw the effect, although the relief did not last long because her Origin energy was rapidly decreasing.

Even though Sevenfold Omen worked indirectly, she was still forcing a curse onto Selene’s Blood Sovereign body, and the resistance generated by Selene’s awakened inheritance was far stronger than she had anticipated.

The evidence was visible in the six purple symbols themselves, which were flickering repeatedly as they struggled to maintain their influence, with the sixth omen in particular trembling more violently than the others as it attempted to suppress Selene’s connection to Blood Legion.
"HAH!"
Brynessa seized the opportunity before that resistance could fully overcome her curse.

sentences.text: This was what someone with extraordinary talent could achieve once they had reached a certain level, and this was precisely why Selene had earned another title that had long been associated with her name.

"Scarlet Queen," Marius murmured, and unlike the others, there was almost reverence in his eyes when he spoke those words, because if someone was going to be called a queen, then naturally, she needed a legion worthy of standing beneath her.
Seeing the Scarlet Queen once again, Marius had already forgotten the embarrassing incident from earlier, and his eyes had regained that familiar, almost frantic fascination.

He knew that Selene was a Perfect Vampire, someone born with the potential to rule over the Vampires, and now the awakening of her Demi-God-level innate ability served as further proof of that belief.
From the side, Luke noticed Marius staring at Selene with a foolish smile and couldn’t help feeling confused.
’What’s wrong with him?’
He glanced at Marius for another moment before deciding to ignore him, because even Luke’s attention had been captured by the spectacle unfolding below.
’Even I would have trouble fighting this many opponents at the same level, even if I used some of my larger attacks.’

Luke understood that only his Atlas Titan body could withstand the strain of repeatedly unleashing those high-level techniques, while his other Titan forms would struggle to cross the Mid-B-rank attack threshold if he tried to force out that same kind of destructive power continuously.

Selene remained completely focused on her Blood Legion, paying no attention to the spectral serpent hovering behind her throne, whose size continued increasing with every passing moment, growing by another foot each time it absorbed the energy being fed into it.
Brynessa, meanwhile, had no intention of standing still and allowing the Blood Warriors to surround her.

She moved her thousand-foot-long serpent body through the blood pool and began thrashing from side to side with tremendous force, using her long body and tail to crush the Blood Warriors whenever they came within reach.
BOOM!
BANG!
BAM!

The battlefield immediately became filled with repeated explosions and collisions as her body displaced the surrounding blood, sending waves of crimson liquid surging through the domain while sections of the ground beneath the blood pool were also blasted apart by the force of her movements.
Yet the Blood Warriors continued coming.

They showed no fear and possessed no instinct for self-preservation, rushing toward Brynessa like undead soldiers whose only purpose was to obey Selene’s command, and whenever they reached her enormous body, they drove their blood-forged spears directly into her thick scales.
SHNK!
SHK!
Several spears plunged deep into Brynessa’s body.
"Hiss!"

Pain crossed Brynessa’s expression as she realized that these Blood Warriors were not merely Early B-rank beings in name, because Selene had reinforced their weapons with the authority of her domain, allowing their blood-forged armaments to gain an advantage over Brynessa’s physical characteristics that their raw cultivation alone shouldn’t have provided.
Her naturally powerful body, which should have been capable of resisting attacks from beings of the same rank, was unable to completely stop those spears from piercing through her scales.
"Damn this domain!"

Brynessa immediately understood where the problem came from, because inside Selene’s Blood World, the Blood Warriors were not fighting as ordinary summoned creatures anymore; they were extensions of the domain itself, and the surrounding blood allowed Selene to continuously reinforce and replace them.

With that realization, Brynessa suddenly twisted her entire body and unleashed a violent thrashing motion, driving her enormous form against the blood-covered ground with such force that more than a hundred meters of the battlefield were destroyed beneath her body while dozens upon dozens of Blood Warriors were crushed in the same movement.
BOOOOM!

The impact sent blood surging into the air, and Brynessa emerged from the disturbed pool with her body covered in blood, some of it belonging to the battlefield while the rest came from her own wounds.
She looked around.
"Damn it."

Her expression became increasingly grim as she saw what had happened, because although she had destroyed a large number of Blood Warriors, the blood pool around her immediately began moving again, and new Blood Warriors started rising from it to replace the ones she had just killed.
Selene simply kept replenishing her army.

At this rate, Brynessa would eventually lose through exhaustion alone, because every movement she made consumed stamina and Origin energy, while Selene could continue drawing upon the blood within her domain to restore her legion.
And above her, the crimson sigil created by Crimson Throne’s Judgment was still present, constantly pressing down on her body and making her movements even more difficult.
Brynessa’s serpentine eyes turned toward Selene.

The Blood Sovereign still sat calmly upon her Crimson Throne, with her posture carrying the composure of a true queen who had no reason to rise from her seat while an entire army fought on her behalf.
’Bastard.’
Brynessa cursed internally before deciding to activate her Sevenfold Omen.
"Sevenfold Omen"
Type: Origin Ability
Classification: Prophetic Curse Magic
Brynessa creates seven small purple symbols around a cursed enemy.
Each symbol represents a possible consequence of the curse and activates according to the target’s actions.
One omen can suppress movement.
Another can interfere with energy circulation.
Another can weaken regeneration.
Another can distort perception.
Another can increase the curse’s accumulation rate.
Another can temporarily restrict an ability.
The final omen remains sealed until Brynessa chooses to activate it.
The next moment, the first six symbols began glowing brightly around Selene.
Omen I 𖤐
Omen II 𖥂
Omen III 𖦹
Omen IV 𖧧
Omen V 𖨆
Omen VI 𖩧

Before Selene could understand what Brynessa was attempting to accomplish, she suddenly felt her vision become blurred, and almost immediately afterward, the movements of her Blood Sovereign body began feeling sluggish as though invisible weight had been placed upon every part of her form.
Her internal energy circulation also slowed, and several other subtle changes began occurring throughout her body.
But one of the most noticeable changes was happening behind her.
The spectral serpent had already grown far larger than before, and its body was now nearly one hundred feet long.
Selene remained confused by the strange creature, but before she could focus on it, she felt another disturbance.
Her connection with the Blood Legion suddenly began weakening.
It felt as though something was trying to sever the link between herself and the army she had created.
For a brief moment, it actually succeeded.

All around Brynessa, the Blood Warriors suddenly became directionless, their crimson heads turning and moving without any clear focus as the connection controlling them weakened, and several of them even began attacking one another instead of continuing their assault on Brynessa.
"Hiss!"
Brynessa released a breath of relief as she saw the effect, although the relief did not last long because her Origin energy was rapidly decreasing.

Even though Sevenfold Omen worked indirectly, she was still forcing a curse onto Selene’s Blood Sovereign body, and the resistance generated by Selene’s awakened inheritance was far stronger than she had anticipated.

The evidence was visible in the six purple symbols themselves, which were flickering repeatedly as they struggled to maintain their influence, with the sixth omen in particular trembling more violently than the others as it attempted to suppress Selene’s connection to Blood Legion.
"HAH!"
Brynessa seized the opportunity before that resistance could fully overcome her curse.

chapters.title: Chapter 326: The Snake Princess Has Been Waiting for This! [GOLDEN TICKET BONUS]
paragraphs: She swung her enormous serpent body and launched several of the Blood Warriors still attacking her aside, clearing a path through the crimson battlefield before suddenly accelerating toward Selene.

Her thousand-foot-long body moved through the blood pool with such force that the liquid in front of her began surging outward, creating the appearance of a moving crimson tide following the advance of a gigantic serpent.
Selene noticed Brynessa rapidly closing the distance.

She also realized that maintaining her current position while under the effects of Sevenfold Omen would not be enough, so she decided to use some of her larger abilities, even though the spectral serpent behind her continued growing at an alarming rate.

Earlier, it had behaved like a harmless creature drifting behind her throne, but now it had even hissed at her, which made Selene feel as though the ungrateful snake had consumed her power to grow stronger and had now decided to show its fangs toward the very person feeding it.
She had no time to deal with it.
"CRIMSON CHAINS"
The instant Selene activated the ability, her Crimson Throne glowed once again, and the blood pool surrounding the battlefield began violently churning.

A vibration spread through the ground that resembled the onset of an earthquake, and immediately afterward, one hundred crimson chains erupted from beneath the blood-covered earth around Brynessa’s serpent body.
FWOOSH!
FWOOSH!
FWOOSH!
The chains shot upward one after another before wrapping around Brynessa’s body, and their sharpened ends embedded themselves directly into her flesh, anchoring her enormous serpent form in place.
SHHNNG!
SHHNNG!
SHHNNG!
"AGHHHH!"

Brynessa screamed in pain as the chains pierced her body and pulled against her movements, but Selene didn’t slow down, because although the six purple omens continued glowing and attempting to interfere with her abilities, her Blood Sovereign body was not merely a decorative transformation, and it continued resisting the curse with everything it possessed.
The purple sigils flickered violently as Selene’s innate ability fought against their influence.
Then Selene raised her hand again.
"CRIMSON ARSENAL"
The instant she activated the technique, the blood filling the domain began rising from the pool, lifting into the air as wave after wave of crimson liquid gathered above the battlefield.
The blood gradually hardened.
One weapon became another, and soon thousands of different blood-forged weapons had formed throughout the sky, each one compressed so densely that they no longer resembled flowing blood at all.

Swords, spears, blades, axes, and countless other weapons floated above Brynessa, suspended in the crimson sky as though an entire arsenal were waiting for Selene’s command before descending upon the serpent below.
From outside the battlefield, the spectators had practically gone numb from the continuous succession of abilities.
Luke was no exception.
He stared downward at the domain, the Blood Legion, the Crimson Chains, and now the thousands of weapons suspended in the sky before finally wondering aloud,
"Was this really a B-rank fight?"

Brynessa had yet to reveal power on the same scale as Selene’s current display, but the sheer size of her serpent body had already made the battle look extraordinary, while Selene continued summoning attacks on a scale that could flatten a city if unleashed without restraint.
Luke had earlier exhausted almost all of his energy merely to manifest Heaven’s Palm, yet his wife was now producing thousands of weapons and commanding an entire legion within a domain.
For a moment, he couldn’t help thinking that his wife was even more frightening than he was.
What he failed to take into account, however, was the enormous difference between their cultivation levels.
Luke was still only D-rank.
Selene was B-rank.
That difference alone changed everything.

For Luke to produce an attack capable of reaching that level while still standing two full realms below the opponent he had challenged was a much greater feat than Selene producing attacks on this scale from her own B-rank cultivation.
Even with all her superior abilities and tools, Selene still couldn’t produce a true A-rank attack, and she hadn’t even reached half the level of an A-rank attack.
Luke, however, didn’t notice that distinction at the moment, because his attention remained completely fixed upon the battlefield below.

The confrontation between the two women had now reached its heated stage, with Brynessa struggling against the restrictions of Selene’s domain while thousands of blood-forged weapons waited above her like a crimson storm held back by nothing more than the will of their queen.
’Damn, she is harder to deal with than I thought.’

Brynessa cursed inwardly as she struggled against Selene’s relentless pressure, because her curse power still hadn’t accumulated enough for her strongest attack, and that particular technique required the accumulated power of a Peak B-rank level curse. She had been deliberately preparing for this moment, believing that once the curse reached that level, she would be able to unleash an attack capable of defeating Selene, and perhaps even killing her.
But Selene was making that plan far more difficult than she had anticipated.
Meanwhile, Selene continued her assault without giving Brynessa enough time to breathe, and after gathering the thousands of blood-forged weapons above the battlefield, she slowly lowered her hand.

The instant her hand moved downward, the weapons hanging within the crimson sky responded to her command, and spears, swords, blades, axes, and thousands other forms of blood-forged weaponry accelerated toward Brynessa with tremendous momentum, descending from every direction like a violent crimson rain.
"NO!"

Seeing the incoming attack, Brynessa immediately activated another one of her curse abilities, although by this point she wasn’t even sure whether she should continue calling these powers curses or Fate abilities herself.
"C̷u̷r̷s̷e̷d̷ ̷R̷e̷f̷l̷e̷c̷t̷i̷o̷n̷"

When a cursed enemy uses a powerful ability against Brynessa, she can reflect a portion of the attack’s hostile energy back into the curse, and rather than returning that energy as ordinary damage, the reflected energy increases the accumulated power of the curse itself.
That was exactly what Brynessa was counting on.

She knew that her curse power couldn’t accumulate quickly enough through time alone, so she had deliberately allowed herself to take greater injuries in exchange for increasing the curse’s accumulated power, accepting the damage because she believed the final result would be worth the price.
The next instant, purple light began spreading across her gigantic serpent body, and almost simultaneously, the blood-forged weapons finally reached her.
BOOM!
BANG!
BAM!
THUD!
CRASH!
SLASH!

Every weapon created its own impact as it struck Brynessa, and the sounds merged into a continuous barrage that resembled cannons exploding against her body, with blades cutting through scales, spears punching into flesh, and the force of the impacts sending blood surging outward through the surrounding pool.
"HIIIISSSH!"
Brynessa’s pained hiss echoed throughout the battlefield, causing both Mella and Marrec’s expressions to tighten with worry.
"Miss Brynessa..."

Neither of them moved, however, because they trusted her judgment and knew that she had deliberately chosen to fight this way, while even if they wanted to help her, they couldn’t do anything because they weren’t allowed to interfere inside the arena.

As the barrage finally subsided, Brynessa’s gigantic body went limp, with numerous cuts running across her scales and blood continuously pouring from the wounds before mixing into the already-red environment around her.
Yet despite the condition of her body, her half-lidded eyes remained fixed on Selene, and a faint smile slowly appeared upon her face.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Luke’s Wife Is Finally in Real Danger! [GOLDEN TICKET BONUS]
paragraphs: There were also several cuts across Selene’s Blood Sovereign body.
The wounds were already beginning to recover, but compared with her normal regeneration, the restoration was noticeably slower.
Brynessa, however, wasn’t smiling because of those injuries.
Her gaze had shifted toward the spectral serpent behind Selene.
It had now grown to one thousand feet long.

The same creature that had once appeared almost harmless was now comparable in size to Brynessa’s own serpent body, and instead of merely floating behind the throne with its mouth closed, it had begun baring its fangs toward Selene.
Yet it still hadn’t attacked.
It was waiting.
Waiting for the final piece.

Selene and the surrounding spectators had also noticed that the spectral serpent still hadn’t made any direct attack, but Selene no longer cared about it, because she had already decided that this battle needed to end, and the simplest way to accomplish that was to kill the curse user herself.
"It’s over, Brynessa," Selene muttered as she slowly raised the hand of her Blood Sovereign form.
’B-RANK INNATE ABILITY!’
’Blood Sovereign, ULTIMATE SKILL!’
Selene gradually closed the gigantic blood hand until only one finger remained extended, with that single finger pointing directly toward Brynessa’s battered and weakened body.
"SOVEREIGN EXECUTION"

The moment those words escaped her mouth, the Blood Sovereign guided its extended finger through the air in one smooth horizontal motion, drawing an invisible boundary across everything within its path.
The instant the movement was completed, a colossal blood-red line appeared in the air exactly along the path traced by the finger, stretching across the battlefield with absolute precision.

It wasn’t an ordinary blade or projectile that traveled toward its target, because the Blood Sovereign’s blood authority had manifested directly along the line itself, turning the very space it occupied into a boundary capable of separating whatever crossed it.
And unfortunately for Brynessa, her thousand-foot-long serpent body was directly within that line.

Under the horrified gazes of everyone watching, the blood-red boundary passed cleanly through her enormous body, dividing it horizontally as though the resistance of her scales, flesh, and bones meant nothing before the authority contained within the attack.
Yet immediately after the line crossed everything in its path, nothing appeared to happen.
The ground remained still.
The space remained silent.
Even Brynessa’s enormous serpent body seemed untouched for that brief fraction of a second.
Then a quiet, cutting sound finally echoed across the battlefield.
SSSHHKK...

That single sound carried farther than the previous explosions had, and when the delayed effect finally manifested, the ground beneath the attack separated along the same line while Brynessa’s gigantic serpent body also began slowly sliding apart, the two portions losing their connection as one side started falling away from the other.
Everyone watching was horrified.
Yet Brynessa’s dying serpent face still carried a faint smile.

Because at the exact moment Selene had used Sovereign Execution, the spectral serpent behind her had begun growing at an alarming rate, gaining another foot of length with every passing fraction of a second.
But instead of continuing to grow outward where everyone could see it, the spectral serpent suddenly moved toward the purple magic circle beneath Selene’s Crimson Throne.
It descended directly into the formation.
And under Brynessa’s dying but satisfied expression, the spectral serpent completely disappeared inside the purple magic circle.
BAAMM!
Brynessa’s half-cut gigantic serpent body finally crashed into the ground, producing another explosive impact that shattered a large section of the earth beneath her.
Mella and Marrec were left stunned.
The other spectators were equally silent.
The entire arena seemed to have fallen into an unnatural stillness.
Only Peiro, floating above the battlefield, let out a slow sigh.
"It’s too late."
His quiet words had barely left his mouth when the next stage of Brynessa’s plan finally began.
The seven symbols of Sevenfold Omen, which had been floating around Selene all this time, suddenly burst with intense purple light and shot toward her Blood Sovereign body.
TThis time, they didn’t merely surround her. Instead, they merged directly into her.
’What?!’
Selene’s mind screamed, but she immediately discovered that she couldn’t speak.
No, it was worse than that.
She couldn’t feel anything.

Her all senses had disappeared completely, and even the connection between herself and the Crimson Throne, which had felt as natural as an extension of her own body until this moment, had suddenly been severed.
Outside, the World of Crimson began gradually losing its stability as Selene’s control disappeared, and the crimson domain slowly started being cancelled.
The Crimson Throne, however, remained summoned.

It still stood within the battlefield despite Selene no longer controlling it, while Selene’s Blood Sovereign form remained seated upon the throne in complete silence, with the seven purple symbols now embedded deep within its body.
Normally, the Blood Sovereign form should have been forced to revert and disappear once Selene lost control.
But that would only have been true if her innate ability had not inherited properties from a Demi-God, or if the technique itself had not originally been created through Demi-God-level power.
Because of that inherited property, the Blood Sovereign form remained.

And then, before anyone could understand what was happening, a gigantic, thick purple thread suddenly emerged and wrapped tightly around the Blood Sovereign’s body, binding it so firmly that any movement would be almost impossible.
Everyone stared at the scene in confusion.
"What the heck is going on?"
How could Brynessa still be doing something when her body had already been cut apart and she had seemingly died?
That was the question appearing in everyone’s minds.
Brynessa’s magic had continued. Her curses had not died with her.
Yet almost everyone had forgotten one crucial detail.
From the beginning of this battle, Peiro had never declared the winner.
He always announced the result whenever one side surrendered, or when one side—
Died.
And so everyone continued watching the battlefield without realizing that the fight had already entered a completely different stage.

Suddenly, the purple magic circle beneath Selene’s Crimson Throne began rippling violently with purple light, and the entire formation trembled before releasing a sound like the world itself was being shattered apart.
BOOOOOOM!
A gigantic serpent emerged from the magic circle.
It was ten thousand feet long.

Its enormous jaws closed around the Crimson Throne itself, biting down on the structure as it attempted to crush it, while Selene’s Blood Sovereign form remained seated upon the throne, completely motionless and helpless because she could no longer control her body.
"NOOO!"
Luke’s voice finally exploded through the arena as he saw what was happening.
He immediately attempted to summon Valzareth so that he could use Void Step and reach Selene.
But—
Nothing happened.
Luke’s eyes widened when he realized that he couldn’t make the Void Step work, and his gaze immediately shot upward.
Peiro was looking directly at him.
Earlier, Peiro had allowed Luke to interfere when Kira’s life was in danger, but this time he wasn’t going to allow it again.
He didn’t need to say anything.
The meaning behind his expression was already clear.
Luke understood immediately that no matter what he attempted, Peiro would not permit him to interfere in the battle this time.
But that realization did nothing to calm him.
He was worried.
More than worried.

The sight of the ten-thousand-foot serpent holding Selene’s Crimson Throne between its jaws made Luke feel as though his mind was about to collapse, especially when he saw the first cracks beginning to spread across the throne’s crimson structure.
It was being crushed.
And if the throne shattered, Selene would be exposed completely.
At the same time, inside Luke’s heart, all five golden chains reacted.

They had already been clinging tightly around his heart, but now every one of them suddenly contracted with even greater force, squeezing his heart as though their message had become a command carved directly into his soul.
"Save her, or you will die!"
The contraction continued growing with every passing second, while the mysterious symbols engraved along the chains continued trying to suppress and weaken that pressure.
Yet their efforts were proving insufficient.
The chains kept tightening.
Luke’s heart kept compressing.
And the closer the Crimson Throne came to shattering, the stronger the warning inside his chest became.
At that moment, the System screen appeared directly before him.
[Luke, calm down!]
The System’s voice carried unusual urgency as it attempted to pull him back from the edge.
[Have faith in Selene! She wouldn’t die from this!]
But Luke couldn’t calm himself.
His eyes remained fixed upon the gigantic serpent, and more importantly, upon the Crimson Throne trapped between its jaws, where cracks had already begun spreading across the crimson structure.
It wouldn’t hold for much longer.
And the moment it shattered, Selene would be left completely exposed.
